अन्तरिक्षभवां वाचं खेचराः पुनरब्रुवन् .. 7.1.336.210 ..
16.336.m: Hearing his words and feeling immense compassion, / the sky-dwellers spoke again, voice originating from the sky:

16.336.s:
bhobho rājannṛpaśreṣṭha tyaktvā śokaṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu ..
yena te janakasyāsya bhavetpāpakṣayo mahān .. 211 ..
16.336.d:
भोभो राजन्नृपश्रेष्ठ त्यक्त्वा शोकं वचः शृणु ..
येन ते जनकस्यास्य भवेत्पापक्षयो महान् .. 211 ..
16.336.m: "O king, best of monarchs! Cast off grief and listen to [our] word, / by which a great destruction of sins may occur for this father of yours.

16.336.s:
asti kṣetraṃ mahāsiddhaṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 212 ..
16.336.d:
अस्ति क्षेत्रं महासिद्धं प्रभासमिति विश्रुतम् ..
सर्वपापप्रशमनं महापातकनाशनम् .. 212 ..
16.336.m: There is a greatly accomplished sacred field renowned as Prabhāsa, / the alleviator of all sins, the destroyer of major transgressions.

16.336.s:
brahmatattvaṃ haritattvaṃ rudratattvaṃ tṛtīyakam ..
tasminneva mahākṣetre prabhāse śaṃkarapriye .. 213 ..
16.336.d:
ब्रह्मतत्त्वं हरितत्त्वं रुद्रतत्त्वं तृतीयकम् ..
तस्मिन्नेव महाक्षेत्रे प्रभासे शंकरप्रिये .. 213 ..
16.336.m: The principle of Brahmā, the principle of Hari, and the third, the principle of Rudra, / [are present] in that very great sacred field, Prabhāsa, dear to Śaṃkara.

16.336.s:
śākteyaṃ yadi vā cāṃdraṃ sauraṃ sārasvataṃ tathā ..
āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ cāpi smṛtaṃ kṣetramanuttamam .. 214 ..
16.336.d:
शाक्तेयं यदि वा चांद्रं सौरं सारस्वतं तथा ..
आग्नेयं वारुणं चापि स्मृतं क्षेत्रमनुत्तमम् .. 214 ..
16.336.m: Whether belonging to Śakti, to the moon, to the sun, or belonging to Sarasvatī, / or belonging to Agni, or to Varuṇa—it is remembered as an unsurpassed sacred field.

16.336.s:
brahmāṇḍe yāni tīrthāni purā kṣetrāṇi yāni tu ..
prabhāsamāgamiṣyanti saṃprāpte tu kalau yuge .. 215 ..
16.336.d:
ब्रह्माण्डे यानि तीर्थानि पुरा क्षेत्राणि यानि तु ..
प्रभासमागमिष्यन्ति संप्राप्ते तु कलौ युगे .. 215 ..
16.336.m: Whatever sacred fords and sacred fields there were in the universe anciently, / they will come to Prabhāsa when the Kali age arrives.

16.336.s:
aṣṭau koṭisahasrāṇi aṣṭau koṭiśatāni ca ..
kṣetraṃ rakṣaṃti tatrasthāḥ prabhāsaṃ śāṃkarā gaṇāḥ .. 216 ..
16.336.d:
अष्टौ कोटिसहस्राणि अष्टौ कोटिशतानि च ..
क्षेत्रं रक्षंति तत्रस्थाः प्रभासं शांकरा गणाः .. 216 ..
16.336.m: Eighty million and eighty hundred thousand / attendants belonging to Śaṃkara dwelling there protect the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.336.s:
iyaṃ sarasvatī puṇyā sarvatraiva hi vidyate ..
pañcasrotāḥ prabhāse tu duṣprāpyā tridaśairapi .. 217 ..
16.336.d:
इयं सरस्वती पुण्या सर्वत्रैव हि विद्यते ..
पञ्चस्रोताः प्रभासे तु दुष्प्राप्या त्रिदशैरपि .. 217 ..
16.336.m: This holy Sarasvatī is indeed present everywhere; / but at Prabhāsa it has five streams, difficult to attain even for the thirty [gods].

16.336.s:
tasyā yatpañcamaṃ srotanyaṃkumatyāstaṭāni ca ..
tasya madhye sthitaṃ tīrthaṃ goṣpadeti ca viśrutam .. 218 ..
16.336.d:
तस्या यत्पञ्चमं स्रोतन्यंकुमत्यास्तटानि च ..
तस्य मध्ये स्थितं तीर्थं गोष्पदेति च विश्रुतम् .. 218 ..
16.336.m: Its fifth stream has banks [called] Nyaṅkumatī; / situated in the middle of it is the sacred ford known as Goṣpada.

16.336.s:
tatra pretaśilā madhye pretānāṃ muktidāyikā ..
yatra pretāḥ purā muktā aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ .. 219 ..
16.336.d:
तत्र प्रेतशिला मध्ये प्रेतानां मुक्तिदायिका ..
यत्र प्रेताः पुरा मुक्ता अष्टाविंशतिकोटयः .. 219 ..
16.336.m: There, in its center, is Pretagayā / Pretaśilā, which bestows liberation upon the ghosts, / where in ancient times two hundred and eighty million ghosts were liberated.

16.336.s:
pāpināṃ muktidaṃ tīrthamādyā rudragayā smṛtā ..
tadasmingoṣpadaṃnāma kalau khyātaṃ dharātale .. 7.1.336.220 ..
16.336.d:
पापिनां मुक्तिदं तीर्थमाद्या रुद्रगया स्मृता ..
तदस्मिन्गोष्पदंनाम कलौ ख्यातं धरातले .. 7.1.336.220 ..
16.336.m: It is a sacred ford bestowing liberation upon sinners, remembered as the original Rudragayā; / therefore, named Goṣpada, it is famous on the surface of the earth in the Kali age.

16.336.s:
yadā kṣīrodamathanānniḥsṛtā lokamātaraḥ ..
tadā devaiḥ sametāstu āgatāstīrthasannidhau .. 221 ..
16.336.d:
यदा क्षीरोदमथनान्निःसृता लोकमातरः ..
तदा देवैः समेतास्तु आगतास्तीर्थसन्निधौ .. 221 ..
16.336.m: When the mothers of the world emerged from the churning of the milk-ocean, / they came accompanied by the gods near that sacred ford.

16.336.s:
padaṃ tatra nimagnaṃ ca nandāyāśca śilātale ..
śilāṃ khurāṃkitāṃ dṛṣṭvā jānudeśāṃkitāṃ tathā .. 222 ..
16.336.d:
पदं तत्र निमग्नं च नन्दायाश्च शिलातले ..
शिलां खुरांकितां दृष्ट्वा जानुदेशांकितां तथा .. 222 ..
16.336.m: There the footprint of Nandā sank into the stone surface; / seeing the stone marked with a hoof and marked with the knee region,

16.336.s:
vismitāḥ sarvadevā vai papracchurgāṃ ca nandinīm ..
kimetaddṛśyate devi padaṃ pretaśilātale ..
kathaṃ tu khedaḥ sañjātaścāsmākaṃ skhalanaṃ katham.. 223 ..
16.336.d:
विस्मिताः सर्वदेवा वै पप्रच्छुर्गां च नन्दिनीम् ..
किमेतद्दृश्यते देवि पदं प्रेतशिलातले ..
कथं तु खेदः सञ्जातश्चास्माकं स्खलनं कथम्.. 223 ..
16.336.m: all the gods were astonished and questioned the cow Nandinī: / 'What is this footprint seen here, O goddess, on the surface of the Preta rock? / And how did exhaustion arise, and how did our stumbling occur?'"

16.336.s:
.. nandinyuvāca .. ..
idaṃ mama padaṃ devāḥ śilāsaṃsthaṃ virājate ..
gaganāṃgaṇabhūmisthaṃ candrabiṃbamivāparam.. 224 ..
16.336.d:
.. नन्दिन्युवाच .. ..
इदं मम पदं देवाः शिलासंस्थं विराजते ..
गगनांगणभूमिस्थं चन्द्रबिंबमिवापरम्.. 224 ..
16.336.m: Nandinī said: / "O gods, this footprint of mine shines situated upon the stone, / like a second lunar disc set upon the ground of the courtyard of the sky.

16.336.s:
adyaprabhṛti bho devāstrailokye sacarācare ..
goṣpadaṃnāma vikhyātaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. 225 ..
16.336.d:
अद्यप्रभृति भो देवास्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..
गोष्पदंनाम विख्यातं लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. 225 ..
16.336.m: From this day forth, O gods, in the three worlds with the moving and unmoving, / celebrated by the name Goṣpada, it shall attain renown in the world.

16.336.s:
atrāgatya naro yastu snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati ..
gayāsaptaguṇaṃtasya phalaṃ devā bhaviṣyati .. 226 ..
16.336.d:
अत्रागत्य नरो यस्तु स्नानं श्राद्धं करिष्यति ..
गयासप्तगुणंतस्य फलं देवा भविष्यति .. 226 ..
16.336.m: Whichever man comes here and performs a ritual ablution and an ancestral offering, / his reward, O gods, shall be seven times that of Gayā.

16.336.s:
na vāro na ca nakṣatraṃ na kālastatra kāraṇam..
yadaiva dṛśyate tīrthaṃ tadā parvasahasrakam .. 227 ..
16.336.d:
न वारो न च नक्षत्रं न कालस्तत्र कारणम्..
यदैव दृश्यते तीर्थं तदा पर्वसहस्रकम् .. 227 ..
16.336.m: Neither the day of the week, nor the lunar mansion, nor the time is the determinant there; / whenever the sacred ford is seen, then it is equal to a thousand auspicious occasions.

16.336.s:
athavā parvakāṃkṣā cettāni me śṛṇupārvati ..
ayane viṣuve yugme sāmānye cārkasaṃkrame .. 228 ..
16.336.d:
अथवा पर्वकांक्षा चेत्तानि मे शृणुपार्वति ..
अयने विषुवे युग्मे सामान्ये चार्कसंक्रमे .. 228 ..
16.336.m: Or, if there is a desire for auspicious occasions, hear them from me, O Pārvatī: / at a solstice, an equinox, a pair [of Viṣuvas], and at an ordinary solar transit,

16.336.s:
amāvāsyāṣṭakāyāṃ ca kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ..
ārdrāmaghārohiṇīṣu dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃgame .. 229 ..
16.336.d:
अमावास्याष्टकायां च कृष्णपक्षे विशेषतः ..
आर्द्रामघारोहिणीषु द्रव्यब्राह्मणसंगमे .. 229 ..
16.336.m: on the new-moon day, on the aṣṭakā, and especially during the dark fortnight, / during the asterisms Ārdrā, Maghā, and Rohiṇī, when wealth and brahmins are assembled,

16.336.s:
gajacchāyā vyatīpāte vaidhṛte dhṛtacāmare ..
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ navamyāṃ kārtikasya tu .. 7.1.336.230 ..
16.336.d:
गजच्छाया व्यतीपाते वैधृते धृतचामरे ..
वैशाखस्य तृतीयायां नवम्यां कार्तिकस्य तु .. 7.1.336.230 ..
16.336.m: during a Gajacchāyā conjunction, at a Vyatīpāta, at a Vaidhṛta, when royal whisks are held, / on the third of Vaiśākha, and on the ninth of Kārtika,

16.336.s:
pañcadaśyāṃ ca māghasya nabhasye ca trayodaśīm ..
yugādayaḥ smṛtā hyetāstasminkāle ca vā punaḥ .. 231 ..
16.336.d:
पञ्चदश्यां च माघस्य नभस्ये च त्रयोदशीम् ..
युगादयः स्मृता ह्येतास्तस्मिन्काले च वा पुनः .. 231 ..
16.336.m: on the fifteenth of Māgha, and on the thirteenth of Nabhasya (Bhādrapada)— / these are remembered as the commencements of the yugas; or at that time again,

16.336.s:
manvantarādau kāryaṃ ca tatra śrāddhaṃ vijānatā ..
āśvayukchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārtike tathā ..232..
16.336.d:
मन्वन्तरादौ कार्यं च तत्र श्राद्धं विजानता ..
आश्वयुक्छुक्लनवमी द्वादशी कार्तिके तथा ..232..
16.336.m: and at the commencement of a Manvantara, an ancestral offering should be performed there by one who knows: / on the bright ninth of Āśvayuja, and likewise on the twelfth in Kārtika,"

16.336.s:
tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca ..
phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā .. 233 ..
16.336.d:
तृतीया चैत्रमासस्य तथा भाद्रपदस्य च ..
फाल्गुनस्य त्वमावास्या पौषस्यैकादशी तथा .. 233 ..
16.336.m: The third lunar day of the month of Caitra, and likewise of Bhādrapada, / the new-moon day of Phālguna, and likewise the eleventh day of Pauṣa,

16.336.s:
āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī ..
śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathā''ṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā .. 234 ..
16.336.d:
आषाढस्यापि दशमी माघमासस्य सप्तमी ..
श्रावणस्याष्टमी कृष्णा तथा'ऽषाढी च पूर्णिमा .. 234 ..
16.336.m: the tenth of Āṣāḍha as well, the seventh of the month of Māgha, / the dark eighth of Śrāvaṇa, and likewise the full moon of Āṣāḍha,

16.336.s:
kārtikī phālgunī caiva jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī tathā ..
manvantarādayaścaitā dattasyā kṣayakārikāḥ .. 235 ..
16.336.d:
कार्तिकी फाल्गुनी चैव ज्यैष्ठी पञ्चदशी तथा ..
मन्वन्तरादयश्चैता दत्तस्या क्षयकारिकाः .. 235 ..
16.336.m: and the full moons of Kārttika, Phālguna, and Jyaiṣṭha: / these are the beginnings of the Manvantaras, rendering inexhaustible what is given.

16.336.s:
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ phālgunasya ca ..
pañcamī caitramāsasya tasyaivāṃtyā tathā parā .. 236 ..
16.336.d:
वैशाखस्य तृतीयायां कृष्णायां फाल्गुनस्य च ..
पञ्चमी चैत्रमासस्य तस्यैवांत्या तथा परा .. 236 ..
16.336.m: On the third of Vaiśākha, and the dark [third] of Phālguna, / the fifth of the month of Caitra, and the last [day] of that same month, and the next [day],

16.336.s:
śuklā trayo daśī māghe kārtikasya tu saptamī ..
navamī mārgaśīrṣasya saptaitāḥ kalpakādimāḥ .. 237 ..
16.336.d:
शुक्ला त्रयो दशी माघे कार्तिकस्य तु सप्तमी ..
नवमी मार्गशीर्षस्य सप्तैताः कल्पकादिमाः .. 237 ..
16.336.m: the bright thirteenth in Māgha, and the seventh of Kārttika, / the ninth of Mārgaśīrṣa—these seven are the beginnings of Kalpas.

16.336.s:
kalpatṛptirbhavecchrāddhe kalpādau tu kṛte purā ..
ityevamuktvā sā nandā devānāṃ pratinandinī ..
antarddhānaṃ jagāmāśu dīpo vātahato yathā ..238..
16.336.d:
कल्पतृप्तिर्भवेच्छ्राद्धे कल्पादौ तु कृते पुरा ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा नन्दा देवानां प्रतिनन्दिनी ..
अन्तर्द्धानं जगामाशु दीपो वातहतो यथा ..238..
16.336.m: Satisfaction lasting an entire Kalpa is attained when a śrāddha was performed in ancient times at the beginning of a Kalpa." / Having spoken thus, Nandā, the gladdener of the gods, / vanished swiftly like a lamp blown out by the wind.

16.336.s:
itīdaṃ kautukaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
brahmarṣayo devarṣayaḥ ślokaṃ paurāṇikaṃ jaguḥ .. 239 ..
16.336.d:
इतीदं कौतुकं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
ब्रह्मर्षयो देवर्षयः श्लोकं पौराणिकं जगुः .. 239 ..
16.336.m: Having seen this wonder, all the gods along with Indra, / the brahmin-seers, and the celestial seers sang an ancient verse:

16.336.s:
aho tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ nandāyāstapaso balam ..
sakṛcchrāddhena dattena gayāsaptaguṇaṃ phalam .. 7.1.336.240 ..
16.336.d:
अहो तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं नन्दायास्तपसो बलम् ..
सकृच्छ्राद्धेन दत्तेन गयासप्तगुणं फलम् .. 7.1.336.240 ..
16.336.m: "Oh, the greatness of the sacred ford! The power of Nandā's austerity! / By a single śrāddha offered [here], the fruit is seven times that of Gayā!"

16.336.s:
evamuktvā tatodevāścakruḥ śrāddhādikāṃ kriyām..
yathoktaṃ phalamāpuste naṃdinyā pūrvabhāṣitam .. 241 ..
16.336.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततोदेवाश्चक्रुः श्राद्धादिकां क्रियाम्..
यथोक्तं फलमापुस्ते नंदिन्या पूर्वभाषितम् .. 241 ..
16.336.m: Having spoken thus, the gods then performed the rite of śrāddha and the rest; / they obtained the stated reward that had previously been declared by Nandinī.

16.336.s:
itthaṃ tvamapi rājendra gaccha śīghraṃ hi goṣpadam..
tatra śrāddhādikaṃ kṛtvā lapsyase phalamīpsitam .. 242 ..
16.336.d:
इत्थं त्वमपि राजेन्द्र गच्छ शीघ्रं हि गोष्पदम्..
तत्र श्राद्धादिकं कृत्वा लप्स्यसे फलमीप्सितम् .. 242 ..
16.336.m: "Likewise you too, O best of kings, go quickly to Goṣpada; / having performed the śrāddha and other rites there, you will attain the desired fruit.

16.336.s:
ayaṃ te janako rājanpāpināṃ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
nānyaistīrthaśataiḥ śakyaḥ proddhartuṃ goṣpadaṃ vinā .. 243 ..
16.336.d:
अयं ते जनको राजन्पापिनां प्रवरः स्मृतः ..
नान्यैस्तीर्थशतैः शक्यः प्रोद्धर्तुं गोष्पदं विना .. 243 ..
16.336.m: This father of yours, O king, is regarded as foremost among sinners; / he cannot be fully redeemed by hundreds of other sacred fords, without Goṣpada.

16.336.s:
tasmādvraja mahārāja mā kārṣīstvaṃ vilaṃbanam ..
evaṃ śrutvā tadā rājā prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ ..244..
16.336.d:
तस्माद्व्रज महाराज मा कार्षीस्त्वं विलंबनम् ..
एवं श्रुत्वा तदा राजा प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः ..244..
16.336.m: Therefore proceed, O great king; do not delay." / Having heard this, the king then came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.336.s:
tatra sthānasthitānviprāṃstīrthamāhātmyakovidān..
agrekṛtya mahārājo yayau nyaṃkumatīṃ nadīm .. 245 ..
16.336.d:
तत्र स्थानस्थितान्विप्रांस्तीर्थमाहात्म्यकोविदान्..
अग्रेकृत्य महाराजो ययौ न्यंकुमतीं नदीम् .. 245 ..
16.336.m: Placing the brahmins residing in that place, who were experts in the greatness of the sacred ford, / at his head, the great king went to the Nyaṅkumatī river.

16.336.s:
tai rājño darśitaṃ tīrthaṃ padaṃ pretaśilāsthitam ..
taddṛṣṭvā vimalaṃ tīrthaṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ ..
cakre kuṇḍāni vedīśca maṇḍapānyajñasiddhaye .. 246 ..
16.336.d:
तै राज्ञो दर्शितं तीर्थं पदं प्रेतशिलास्थितम् ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा विमलं तीर्थं विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
चक्रे कुण्डानि वेदीश्च मण्डपान्यज्ञसिद्धये .. 246 ..
16.336.m: They showed the king the sacred ford, the footprint situated upon the Preteśilā. / Having seen that pure sacred ford, with eyes wide open in amazement, / he constructed fire-pits, altars, and pavilions for the accomplishment of the sacrifice.

16.336.s:
tato yajñaḥ samārabdho vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaḥ ..
pratyakṣaṃ pitara stasya babhūvurjvalanaprabhāḥ .. 247 ..
16.336.d:
ततो यज्ञः समारब्धो विधिवद्भूरिदक्षिणः ..
प्रत्यक्षं पितर स्तस्य बभूवुर्ज्वलनप्रभाः .. 247 ..
16.336.m: Then the sacrifice was commenced according to the rule, with abundant sacrificial gifts; / his ancestors visibly appeared, blazing with the radiance of fire.

16.336.s:
tataḥ śraddhāṃ samāsthāya śrāddhairyajñairmahodayam ..
te cābruvanvacastuṣṭāḥ pitaro rājasattamam .. 248 ..
16.336.d:
ततः श्रद्धां समास्थाय श्राद्धैर्यज्ञैर्महोदयम् ..
ते चाब्रुवन्वचस्तुष्टाः पितरो राजसत्तमम् .. 248 ..
16.336.m: Then, having undertaken great prosperity with faith through śrāddhas and sacrifices, / those gratified ancestors spoke a word to the best of kings:

16.336.s:
dhanyo'si rājanpuṇyo'si vayaṃ dhanyatarāstvayā ..
yadatra tīrthe śrāddhena uddhṛtā bhavatā vayam .. 249 ..
16.336.d:
धन्योऽसि राजन्पुण्योऽसि वयं धन्यतरास्त्वया ..
यदत्र तीर्थे श्राद्धेन उद्धृता भवता वयम् .. 249 ..
16.336.m: "Blessed are you, O king! Virtuous are you! We are made far more blessed through you, / since by means of the śrāddha at this sacred ford, we have been redeemed by you."

16.336.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ sarve venena pitaraḥ saha ..
vimānavarasaṃsthāśca jagmuste tridivālayam .. 7.1.336.250 ..
16.336.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सर्वे वेनेन पितरः सह ..
विमानवरसंस्थाश्च जग्मुस्ते त्रिदिवालयम् .. 7.1.336.250 ..
16.336.m: Having spoken thus, all the ancestors then, along with Vena, / mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot and went to heaven, the abode of the gods.

16.336.s:
gacchannuvāca venastaṃ rājānaṃ pṛthuvakṣasam ..
rājañjanmāni catvāri abhūvaṃ cānyajanmani .. 251 ..
16.336.d:
गच्छन्नुवाच वेनस्तं राजानं पृथुवक्षसम् ..
राजञ्जन्मानि चत्वारि अभूवं चान्यजन्मनि .. 251 ..
16.336.m: Departing, Vena spoke to that broad-chested king: / "O king, for four lifetimes and in another birth

16.336.s:
kuṣṭhī pāpo durācāraścāṃḍālocchiṣṭabhuktathā ..
so'haṃ pāpavinirmukto gacchāmi tridivālayam .. 252 ..
16.336.d:
कुष्ठी पापो दुराचारश्चांडालोच्छिष्टभुक्तथा ..
सोऽहं पापविनिर्मुक्तो गच्छामि त्रिदिवालयम् .. 252 ..
16.336.m: I was a leper, a sinner, of wicked conduct, and one who ate the leavings of a caṇḍāla; / that very I, completely freed from sin, am going to heaven, the abode of the gods.

16.336.s:
tadgaccha tvaṃ mahābhāga rājyaṃ bhuṃkṣva cirāya ca ..
kṛtaṃ te sakalaṃ kāryaṃ putreṇa kriyate ca yat .. 253 ..
16.336.d:
तद्गच्छ त्वं महाभाग राज्यं भुंक्ष्व चिराय च ..
कृतं ते सकलं कार्यं पुत्रेण क्रियते च यत् .. 253 ..
16.336.m: Therefore go, O fortunate one, and enjoy your kingdom for a long time; / every duty has been done by you that is performed by a son."

16.336.s:
evaṃ śrutvā tadā rājā mumude jñātisaṃyutaḥ ..
brāhmaṇānharṣayāmāsa dānairbhūkāṃcanādibhiḥ .. 254 ..
16.336.d:
एवं श्रुत्वा तदा राजा मुमुदे ज्ञातिसंयुतः ..
ब्राह्मणान्हर्षयामास दानैर्भूकांचनादिभिः .. 254 ..
16.336.m: Having heard this, the king then rejoiced together with his kinsmen; / he gladdened the brahmins with gifts of land, gold, and other riches.

16.336.s:
na tadasti jagatyasmiṃstatra yanna dadau nṛpaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā prabhāvaṃ tīrthasya pratyakṣaṃ pitṛdarśanam ..255..
16.336.d:
न तदस्ति जगत्यस्मिंस्तत्र यन्न ददौ नृपः ..
दृष्ट्वा प्रभावं तीर्थस्य प्रत्यक्षं पितृदर्शनम् ..255..
16.336.m: There was nothing in this world that the king did not give there, / having witnessed the power of the sacred ford and the direct sight of the ancestors.

16.336.s:
evaṃ rājā sa kṛtvā tu svakīyaṃ sthāna māyayau ..
bhuktvā bhūmiṃ tu sakalāṃ pretya svargaṃ samāptavān .. 256 ..
16.336.d:
एवं राजा स कृत्वा तु स्वकीयं स्थान माययौ ..
भुक्त्वा भूमिं तु सकलां प्रेत्य स्वर्गं समाप्तवान् .. 256 ..
16.336.m: Having acted thus, that king returned to his own abode; / having enjoyed the entire earth, he attained heaven after death.

16.336.s:
evaṃ prabhāvaṃ tatkṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
yasminnāyāṃti tīrthāni devāstiṣṭhaṃti koṭiśaḥ .. 257 ..
16.336.d:
एवं प्रभावं तत्क्षेत्रं प्रभासं पापनाशनम् ..
यस्मिन्नायांति तीर्थानि देवास्तिष्ठंति कोटिशः .. 257 ..
16.336.m: Such is the power of that sacred field, Prabhāsa, destroying sins, / to which sacred fords come and gods dwell by the millions.

16.336.s:
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya yonyattīrthaṃ hi mārgate ..
sa karasthaṃ samutsṛjya kūrpareṇa samālihet .. 258 ..
16.336.d:
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य योन्यत्तीर्थं हि मार्गते ..
स करस्थं समुत्सृज्य कूर्परेण समालिहेत् .. 258 ..
16.336.m: Whoever, having reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa, seeks another sacred ford, / casts away what is held in his hand and licks his elbow.

16.336.s:
abruvanpitaraścaināṃ gāthāṃ paurāṇikīṃ priye ..
gayāṃ gaṃtuṃ na śaknoti yadi putraḥ kathaṃcana ..
tadā yatnena gaṃtavyaṃ goṣpadaṃ tīrthamuttamam .. 259 ..
16.336.d:
अब्रुवन्पितरश्चैनां गाथां पौराणिकीं प्रिये ..
गयां गंतुं न शक्नोति यदि पुत्रः कथंचन ..
तदा यत्नेन गंतव्यं गोष्पदं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 259 ..
16.336.m: The ancestors also recited this ancient verse, O beloved: / 'If a son is somehow unable to go to Gayā, / then he must make an effort to go to the excellent sacred ford of Goṣpada.

16.336.s:
kandairmūlaiḥ phalairvāpi piṇyākeṃgudakena vā ..
api naḥ sa kule bhūyādyo'tra śrāddhaṃ pradāsyati .. 7.1.336.260 ..
16.336.d:
कन्दैर्मूलैः फलैर्वापि पिण्याकेंगुदकेन वा ..
अपि नः स कुले भूयाद्योऽत्र श्राद्धं प्रदास्यति .. 7.1.336.260 ..
16.336.m: Even with tubers, roots, fruits, or oilcake and water from ingudī: / may he be born in our lineage who will offer a śrāddha here!'

16.336.s:
tatra snātvā prayatnena brāhmaṇānvedavittamān ..
āmaṃtrya vidhivacchrāddhe bhojayitvā prayatnataḥ ..
piṃḍadānaṃ tu karttavyaṃ pitṛṇāṃ tṛptimicchatām ..261..
16.336.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा प्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणान्वेदवित्तमान् ..
आमंत्र्य विधिवच्छ्राद्धे भोजयित्वा प्रयत्नतः ..
पिंडदानं तु कर्त्तव्यं पितृणां तृप्तिमिच्छताम् ..261..
16.336.m: Having bathed there with effort, having invited brahmins who know the Vedas best / according to rule for the śrāddha and carefully fed them, / an offering of rice-balls must be made by those desiring the satisfaction of the ancestors.

16.336.s:
na tithirna ca nakṣatraṃ parva māsādikaṃ na hi ..
sarvadā tatra gaṃtavyaṃ śraddhā yuktena cetasā .. 262 ..
16.336.d:
न तिथिर्न च नक्षत्रं पर्व मासादिकं न हि ..
सर्वदा तत्र गंतव्यं श्रद्धा युक्तेन चेतसा .. 262 ..
16.336.m: No lunar day, no lunar mansion, nor any sacred occasion or month is required; / one must always go there with a mind endowed with faith.

16.336.s:
na kālaniyamastatra pramāṇaṃ darśanaṃ yataḥ ..
tatrākṣayatṛtīyāyāṃ durllabhaṃ gamanaṃ priye .. 263 ..
16.336.d:
न कालनियमस्तत्र प्रमाणं दर्शनं यतः ..
तत्राक्षयतृतीयायां दुर्ल्लभं गमनं प्रिये .. 263 ..
16.336.m: There is no restriction of time there, since sight [of it] is the authoritative means; / yet going there on the Akṣayatṛtīyā is rare to attain, O beloved,

16.336.s: kārttikyāṃ māghasaptamyāṃ padmake vā'tha parvaṇi ..264..
16.336.d: कार्त्तिक्यां माघसप्तम्यां पद्मके वाऽथ पर्वणि ..264..
16.336.m: or on the full moon of Kārttika, the seventh of Māgha, or during the Padmaka conjunction.

16.336.s:
hiraṇyadānaṃ godānaṃ vastraṃ rūpyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tilāḥ ..
dātavyāstatra yuktena pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimicchatā .. 265 ..
16.336.d:
हिरण्यदानं गोदानं वस्त्रं रूप्यं घृतं तिलाः ..
दातव्यास्तत्र युक्तेन पितॄणां तृप्तिमिच्छता .. 265 ..
16.336.m: The gift of gold, the gift of a cow, garments, silver, clarified butter, and sesame seeds / should be given there by one who is disciplined, desiring the satisfaction of the ancestors.

16.336.s:
evaṃ te kathitaṃ devi tīrthaguhyaṃ mahodayam ..
na kathyaṃ duṣṭabuddhīnāṃ pāpināṃ krūracetasām ..266..
16.336.d:
एवं ते कथितं देवि तीर्थगुह्यं महोदयम् ..
न कथ्यं दुष्टबुद्धीनां पापिनां क्रूरचेतसाम् ..266..
16.336.m: Thus the secret of the sacred ford, bearing great fruit, has been told to you, O goddess; / it is not to be told to those of wicked intellect, sinners, or those of cruel heart.

16.336.s:
śraddhāyuktāya dātavyaṃ pitṛbhaktiratāya ca ..
śrāddhakāle viśeṣeṇa paṭhe dbhaktyā purāṇavit .. 267 ..
16.336.d:
श्रद्धायुक्ताय दातव्यं पितृभक्तिरताय च ..
श्राद्धकाले विशेषेण पठे द्भक्त्या पुराणवित् .. 267 ..
16.336.m: It should be imparted to one endowed with faith and devoted to filial duty toward the ancestors; / especially at the time of a śrāddha, one who knows the Purāṇas should recite it with devotion.

16.336.s:
pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptistena dvādaśavārṣikī ..
śrotavyaṃ prayatairnityaṃ narairnarakabhīrubhiḥ ..
paṭhitavyaṃ sadā bhaktyā viprāṇāṃ bhuṃjatā puraḥ .. 268 ..
16.336.d:
पितॄणां जायते तृप्तिस्तेन द्वादशवार्षिकी ..
श्रोतव्यं प्रयतैर्नित्यं नरैर्नरकभीरुभिः ..
पठितव्यं सदा भक्त्या विप्राणां भुंजता पुरः .. 268 ..
16.336.m: Through this, satisfaction lasting twelve years arises for the ancestors; / it should constantly be heard with self-restraint by men who fear hell; / it should always be recited with devotion before brahmins while they are eating.

16.336.s:
pānīyamapyatra tilairvimiśraṃ dadyātpitṛbhyaḥ prayato manuṣyaḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena samāsahasraṃ rahasyametatpitaro vadaṃti ..269..
16.336.d:
पानीयमप्यत्र तिलैर्विमिश्रं दद्यात्पितृभ्यः प्रयतो मनुष्यः ..
श्राद्धं कृतं तेन समासहस्रं रहस्यमेतत्पितरो वदंति ..269..
16.336.m: Even water mixed with sesame seeds, if a restrained man offers it here to the ancestors, / a śrāddha for a thousand years is performed by him; thus the ancestors proclaim this secret.

16.336.s:
idaṃ rahasya yaśaso nidhānamidaṃ pitṝṇāmativallabhaṃ ca ..
idaṃ ca vedeṣvamṛtāya nityamidaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ ca puṃsām .. 7.1.336.270 ..
16.336.d:
इदं रहस्य यशसो निधानमिदं पितॄणामतिवल्लभं च ..
इदं च वेदेष्वमृताय नित्यमिदं महापापहरं च पुंसाम् .. 7.1.336.270 ..
16.336.m: This secret is the receptacle of fame; this is exceedingly dear to the ancestors; / this is eternal in the Vedas for immortality, and this destroys the great sins of mortals.

16.336.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīnadīmāhātmye goṣpadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 336 ..
16.336.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीनदीमाहात्म्ये गोष्पदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 336 ..
16.336.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Greatness of the Sacred Ford of Goṣpada' in the Greatness of the Nyaṅkumatī River, in the first [part], the Greatness of the Prabhāsa Field, in the seventh Section on Prabhāsa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.337.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi nārāyaṇagṛhaṃ param ..
goṣpadāddakṣiṇe bhāge sāgarasya taṭe śubhe .. 1 ..
16.337.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि नारायणगृहं परम् ..
गोष्पदाद्दक्षिणे भागे सागरस्य तटे शुभे .. 1 ..
16.337.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme abode of Nārāyaṇa, / situated to the south of Goṣpada on the auspicious shore of the ocean, 1

16.337.s:
nyaṃkumatyāḥ samīpe tu sarvapātakanāśane ..
tatrakalpāṃtarasthāyī svayaṃ tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ .. 2 ..
16.337.d:
न्यंकुमत्याः समीपे तु सर्वपातकनाशने ..
तत्रकल्पांतरस्थायी स्वयं तिष्ठति केशवः .. 2 ..
16.337.m: near the Nyaṅkumatī, which destroys all sins. / There Keśava himself stays, abiding until the end of the kalpa, 2

16.337.s:
pitṝṇāmuddharaṇārthāya hyasminraudre kalau yuge ..
yadā daityavināśaṃ sa kurute bhagavānhariḥ .. 3 ..
16.337.d:
पितॄणामुद्धरणार्थाय ह्यस्मिन्रौद्रे कलौ युगे ..
यदा दैत्यविनाशं स कुरुते भगवान्हरिः .. 3 ..
16.337.m: for the sake of delivering the ancestors in this terrible Kali age. / Whenever the blessed lord Hari causes the destruction of the Daityas, 3

16.337.s:
viśrāmārthaṃ tadā tatra gṛhe tiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ ..
nārāyaṇagṛhaṃ tena vikhyātaṃ jagatītale .. 4..
16.337.d:
विश्रामार्थं तदा तत्र गृहे तिष्ठति नित्यशः ..
नारायणगृहं तेन विख्यातं जगतीतले .. 4..
16.337.m: he always remains in that house for the sake of resting. / Therefore it became renowned upon the surface of the earth as Nārāyaṇagṛha. 4

16.337.s:
kṛte janārdanonāma tretāyāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ..
dvāpare puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kalau nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
16.337.d:
कृते जनार्दनोनाम त्रेतायां मधुसूदनः ..
द्वापरे पुण्डरीकाक्षः कलौ नारायणः स्मृतः .. 5 ..
16.337.m: In the Kṛta age he is remembered as Janārdana, in the Tretā age as Madhusūdana, / in the Dvāpara as Puṇḍarīkākṣa, and in the Kali age as Nārāyaṇa. 5

16.337.s:
evaṃ caturyuge prāpte punaḥpunararindama ..
kṛtvā dharmavyavasthānaṃ tatsthānaṃ pratipadyate .. 6 ..
16.337.d:
एवं चतुर्युगे प्राप्ते पुनःपुनररिन्दम ..
कृत्वा धर्मव्यवस्थानं तत्स्थानं प्रतिपद्यते .. 6 ..
16.337.m: When each of the four ages arrives in this way again and again, O tamer of foes, / having established dharma, he repairs to that place. 6

16.337.s:
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yastaṃ devaṃ prapaśyati ..
sa paśyati dhruvaṃ sthāne pratyānantaṃ hareḥ padam .. 7..
16.337.d:
एकादश्यां निराहारो यस्तं देवं प्रपश्यति ..
स पश्यति ध्रुवं स्थाने प्रत्यानन्तं हरेः पदम् .. 7..
16.337.m: Whoever, fasting on an Ekādaśī, beholds that god, / truly beholds the eternal abode of Hari in that place. 7

16.337.s:
tena pītāni vastrāṇi deyāni dvijapuṃgave ..
snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 8 ..
16.337.d:
तेन पीतानि वस्त्राणि देयानि द्विजपुंगवे ..
स्नानं श्राद्धं च कर्तव्यं सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 8 ..
16.337.m: Yellow garments should be given by him to an eminent twice-born; / a ritual ablution and an ancestral rite should be performed by those desiring the complete fruit of the pilgrimage. 8

16.337.s:
iti te kathitaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ harisaṃketaniketanodbhavam ..
śṛṇute vā prayatastu yaḥ sudhīḥ paṭhate vā labhate sa sadgatim .. 9 ..
16.337.d:
इति ते कथितं महाप्रभावं हरिसंकेतनिकेतनोद्भवम् ..
शृणुते वा प्रयतस्तु यः सुधीः पठते वा लभते स सद्गतिम् .. 9 ..
16.337.m: Thus has been spoken to you the great power arising from the chosen dwelling place of Hari; / whatever wise person, being restrained, hears it or recites it, attains the good path. 9

16.337.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye nārāyaṇagṛhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 337 ..
16.337.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीमाहात्म्ये नारायणगृहमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 337 ..
16.337.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirty-seventh chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Nārāyaṇagṛha' in the Greatness of the Nyaṅkumatī, in the Greatness of Prabhāsakṣetra, in the first [part], in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the seventh [book], in the Saṃhitā of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 337

16.338.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devikātaṭasaṃsthitam ..
jāleśvareti vikhyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam .. 1 ..
16.338.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देविकातटसंस्थितम् ..
जालेश्वरेति विख्यातं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् .. 1 ..
16.338.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the [liṅga] situated on the bank of the Devikā, / renowned as Jāleśvara, worshipped by gods and asuras. 1

16.338.s:
manvantare cākṣuṣe ca samprāpte dvāpare yuge ..
nāmnā jāleśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ devikātaṭasaṃsthitam .. 2 ..
16.338.d:
मन्वन्तरे चाक्षुषे च सम्प्राप्ते द्वापरे युगे ..
नाम्ना जालेश्वरं लिंगं देविकातटसंस्थितम् .. 2 ..
16.338.m: In the Cākṣuṣa Manvantara, when the Dvāpara age arrived, / the liṅga situated on the bank of the Devikā became known by the name Jāleśvara. 2

16.338.s:
pūjyate nāgakanyābhirna tatpaśyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
mahā tejomaṇimayaṃ caṃdrabiṃbasamaprabham ..
smaraṇāttasya devasya brahmahatyā praṇaśyati .. 3 ..
16.338.d:
पूज्यते नागकन्याभिर्न तत्पश्यंति मानवाः ..
महा तेजोमणिमयं चंद्रबिंबसमप्रभम् ..
स्मरणात्तस्य देवस्य ब्रह्महत्या प्रणश्यति .. 3 ..
16.338.m: It is worshipped by nāga maidens; mortal men do not see it. / Made of jewels of great splendour, having a radiance like the orb of the moon, / from the mere remembrance of that god, the sin of killing a brahmin is destroyed. 3

16.338.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ jāleśvaraṃ nāma kasminkāle babhūva tat .. 4 ..
16.338.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं जालेश्वरं नाम कस्मिन्काले बभूव तत् .. 4 ..
16.338.m: The goddess said: / How did that name Jāleśvara come to be, and at what time did it happen? 4

16.338.s:
sādhubhiḥ saha saṃvāsātke guṇāḥ parikīrttitāḥ ..
ke lokāḥ kāni puṇyāni tatsarvaṃ śaṃsa me prabho .. 5 ..
16.338.d:
साधुभिः सह संवासात्के गुणाः परिकीर्त्तिताः ..
के लोकाः कानि पुण्यानि तत्सर्वं शंस मे प्रभो .. 5 ..
16.338.m: What virtues are proclaimed from residing together with the virtuous? / What worlds, and what merits [are attained]? Proclaim all that to me, O Lord. 5

16.338.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atraivodāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
nābhāgasya ca saṃvādamāpastaṃbataponidheḥ .. 6 ..
16.338.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अत्रैवोदाहरंतीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ..
नाभागस्य च संवादमापस्तंबतपोनिधेः .. 6 ..
16.338.m: Īśvara said: / Right here they cite this ancient traditional history: / the conversation between Nābhāga and Āpastamba, a treasury of austerities. 6

16.338.s:
maharṣirātmavānpūrvamāpastaṃbo dvijāgraṇīḥ ..
upāvasansadā rambho babhūva bhagavāṃstadā .. 7 ..
16.338.d:
महर्षिरात्मवान्पूर्वमापस्तंबो द्विजाग्रणीः ..
उपावसन्सदा रम्भो बभूव भगवांस्तदा .. 7 ..
16.338.m: Formerly, the great seer Āpastamba, self-controlled, foremost among the twice-born, / fasting constantly, became a venerable master of self-restraint. 7

16.338.s:
nityaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ drohaṃ visṛjya saḥ ..
devikāsarito madhye viveśa salilāśaye .. 8 ..
16.338.d:
नित्यं क्रोधं च लोभं च मोहं द्रोहं विसृज्य सः ..
देविकासरितो मध्ये विवेश सलिलाशये .. 8 ..
16.338.m: Constantly casting off anger, greed, delusion, and malice, / he entered into the pool of water in the midst of the river Devikā. 8

16.338.s:
kṣetre prābhāsike ramye samyagjñātvā śivapriye ..
tatrāsya vasataḥ kālaḥ samatīto mahāṃstadā .. 9 ..
16.338.d:
क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके रम्ये सम्यग्ज्ञात्वा शिवप्रिये ..
तत्रास्य वसतः कालः समतीतो महांस्तदा .. 9 ..
16.338.m: Knowing it well to be in the delightful Prabhāsa sacred field, dear to Śiva, / while he dwelt there, a long time then passed, 9

16.338.s:
pareṇa dhyānayogena sthāṇubhūtasya tiṣṭhataḥ ..
tataḥ kadācidāgatya taṃ deśaṃ matsyajīvinaḥ .. 7.1.338.10 ..
16.338.d:
परेण ध्यानयोगेन स्थाणुभूतस्य तिष्ठतः ..
ततः कदाचिदागत्य तं देशं मत्स्यजीविनः .. 7.1.338.10 ..
16.338.m: as he remained like a pillar through supreme meditation. / Then, at one time, fishermen came to that region. 10

16.338.s:
prasārya sumahajjālaṃ sarve cākarṣayanbalāt ..
atha taṃ ca mahāmatsyaṃ niṣādā baladarpitāḥ .. 11 ..
16.338.d:
प्रसार्य सुमहज्जालं सर्वे चाकर्षयन्बलात् ..
अथ तं च महामत्स्यं निषादा बलदर्पिताः .. 11 ..
16.338.m: Spreading out a very large net, they all hauled it in by force. / Then those Niṣādas, arrogant with strength, 11

16.338.s:
tasmāduttārayāmāsuḥ salilādbrahmanaṃdanam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tapasā dīptaṃ kaivarttā bhayavihvalāḥ ..
śirobhiḥ praṇipatyoccairidaṃ vacanamabruvan .. 12 .. ..
16.338.d:
तस्मादुत्तारयामासुः सलिलाद्ब्रह्मनंदनम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा तपसा दीप्तं कैवर्त्ता भयविह्वलाः ..
शिरोभिः प्रणिपत्योच्चैरिदं वचनमब्रुवन् .. 12 .. ..
16.338.m: pulled that son of Brahmā out of the water along with the large fish. / Seeing him blazing with austerities, the fishermen, overcome with fear, / bowed down with their heads and loudly spoke these words: 12

16.338.s:
niṣādā ūcuḥ .. ..
ajñānātkṛtapāpānāmasmākaṃ kṣantumarhasi ..
kiṃ vā kāryaṃ priyaṃ te'dya tadājñāpaya suvrata .. 13 ..
16.338.d:
निषादा ऊचुः .. ..
अज्ञानात्कृतपापानामस्माकं क्षन्तुमर्हसि ..
किं वा कार्यं प्रियं तेऽद्य तदाज्ञापय सुव्रत .. 13 ..
16.338.m: The Niṣādas said: / You should forgive us who have committed sin out of ignorance. / Or what pleasing task may be done for you today? Command that, O you of noble vows! 13

16.338.s:
sa munistanmahaddṛṣṭvā matsyānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam..
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo dāśānprovāca duḥkhitaḥ .. 14 ..
16.338.d:
स मुनिस्तन्महद्दृष्ट्वा मत्स्यानां कदनं कृतम्..
कृपया परयाविष्टो दाशान्प्रोवाच दुःखितः .. 14 ..
16.338.m: That sage, seeing that great slaughter made of the fish, / filled with supreme compassion, spoke in sorrow to the fishermen: 14

16.338.s:
kena me syādupāyo hi sarve svārthe bata sthitāḥ ..
jñānināmapi yaccetaḥ kevalātmahite ratam .. 15 ..
16.338.d:
केन मे स्यादुपायो हि सर्वे स्वार्थे बत स्थिताः ..
ज्ञानिनामपि यच्चेतः केवलात्महिते रतम् .. 15 ..
16.338.m: By what means could it be for me? Alas, all are intent upon their own self-interest, / since even the mind of the wise is devoted solely to its own good! 15

16.338.s:
jñāninopi yadā svārthamāśritya dhyānamāsthitāḥ ..
duḥkhārttānīha sattvāni kva yāsyaṃti sukhaṃ tataḥ .. 16 ..
16.338.d:
ज्ञानिनोपि यदा स्वार्थमाश्रित्य ध्यानमास्थिताः ..
दुःखार्त्तानीह सत्त्वानि क्व यास्यंति सुखं ततः .. 16 ..
16.338.m: When even the wise, resorting to self-interest, remain established in meditation, / where then will the beings afflicted by suffering in this world go for happiness? 16

16.338.s:
yo'bhivāṃchati bhoktuṃ vai duḥkhānyekāṃtato janaḥ ..
pāpātpāpataraṃ taṃ hi pravadaṃti mumukṣavaḥ .. 17 ..
16.338.d:
योऽभिवांछति भोक्तुं वै दुःखान्येकांततो जनः ..
पापात्पापतरं तं हि प्रवदंति मुमुक्षवः .. 17 ..
16.338.m: The person who wishes to enjoy exclusively [his own bliss while seeing others'] suffering, / him indeed those desiring liberation declare to be more sinful than the sinful. 17

16.338.s:
ko nu me syādupāyo hi yenāhaṃ duḥkhitātmavān..
aṃtaḥ praviṣṭaḥ sattvānāṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvaduḥkhabhuk .. 18 ..
16.338.d:
को नु मे स्यादुपायो हि येनाहं दुःखितात्मवान्..
अंतः प्रविष्टः सत्त्वानां भवेयं सर्वदुःखभुक् .. 18 ..
16.338.m: What indeed could be the means for me whereby I, feeling the sorrow of others, / entering inside the living beings, might become an experiencer of all their sorrow? 18

16.338.s:
yanmamāsti śubhaṃ kicittadenānupagacchatu ..
yatkṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ taiśca tadaśeṣamupetu mām .. 19 ..
16.338.d:
यन्ममास्ति शुभं किचित्तदेनानुपगच्छतु ..
यत्कृतं दुष्कृतं तैश्च तदशेषमुपेतु माम् .. 19 ..
16.338.m: Whatever good there is of mine, let that go to them; / and whatever evil has been done by them, let that come to me in its entirety. 19

16.338.s:
dṛṣṭvāṃdhānkṛpaṇānvyaṃgānanāthānrogiṇastathā ..
dayā na jāyate yasya sa rakṣa iti me matiḥ .. 7.1.338.20 ..
16.338.d:
दृष्ट्वांधान्कृपणान्व्यंगाननाथान्रोगिणस्तथा ..
दया न जायते यस्य स रक्ष इति मे मतिः .. 7.1.338.20 ..
16.338.m: Seeing the blind, the wretched, the crippled, the helpless, and the diseased, / he in whom compassion does not arise is a demon—such is my view. 20

16.338.s:
prāṇasaṃśayamāpannānprāṇino bhayavihvalān ..
yo na rakṣati śaktopi sa tatpāpaṃ samaśnute .. 21 ..
16.338.d:
प्राणसंशयमापन्नान्प्राणिनो भयविह्वलान् ..
यो न रक्षति शक्तोपि स तत्पापं समश्नुते .. 21 ..
16.338.m: Whoever, even though capable, does not protect living beings that have fallen into mortal danger / and are overcome with fear, incurs their sin. 21

16.338.s:
āhurjanānāmārttānāṃ sukhaṃ yadupajāyate ..
tasya svargo'pavargo vā kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm .. .. 22 ..
16.338.d:
आहुर्जनानामार्त्तानां सुखं यदुपजायते ..
तस्य स्वर्गोऽपवर्गो वा कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् .. .. 22 ..
16.338.m: They say that whatever happiness arises for afflicted people, / heaven or even final liberation is not worth a sixteenth part of that. 22

16.338.s:
tasmānnaitānahaṃ dīnāṃstyaktvā mīnānsuduḥkhitān ..
padamātraṃ tu yāsyāmi kiṃ punastridaśālayam .. 23 ..
16.338.d:
तस्मान्नैतानहं दीनांस्त्यक्त्वा मीनान्सुदुःखितान् ..
पदमात्रं तु यास्यामि किं पुनस्त्रिदशालयम् .. 23 ..
16.338.m: Therefore, abandoning these miserable, intensely suffering fish, / I shall not take even a single step, much less go to the abode of the thirty [gods]. 23

16.338.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
niśamyaitadṛṣervākyaṃ dāśāste jātasaṃbhramāḥ ..
yathāvṛttaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ nābhāgāya nyavedayan .. 24 ..
16.338.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
निशम्यैतदृषेर्वाक्यं दाशास्ते जातसंभ्रमाः ..
यथावृत्तं तु तत्सर्वं नाभागाय न्यवेदयन् .. 24 ..
16.338.m: Īśvara said: / Hearing this speech of the seer, those fishermen, seized with agitation, / reported everything that had happened to Nābhāga. 24

16.338.s:
nābhāgo'pi tataḥ śrutvā taṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmanandanam ..
tvaritaḥ prayayau tatra sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ .. 25 ..
16.338.d:
नाभागोऽपि ततः श्रुत्वा तं द्रष्टुं ब्रह्मनन्दनम् ..
त्वरितः प्रययौ तत्र सामात्यः सपुरोहितः .. 25 ..
16.338.m: Then Nābhāga also, having heard, in order to see that son of Brahmā, / swiftly went there together with his ministers and family priest. 25

16.338.s:
sa samyakpūjayitvā taṃ devakalpamuniṃ nṛpaḥ ..
provāca bhagavanbrūhi kiṃ karomi tavājñayā ..26.. ..
16.338.d:
स सम्यक्पूजयित्वा तं देवकल्पमुनिं नृपः ..
प्रोवाच भगवन्ब्रूहि किं करोमि तवाज्ञया ..26.. ..
16.338.m: Having duly worshipped that godlike sage, the king / said, 'Venerable one, tell me, what shall I do by your command?' 26

16.338.s:
.. āpastaṃba uvāca .. ..
śrameṇa mahatāviṣṭāḥ kaivarttā duḥkhajīvinaḥ ..
mama mūlyaṃ prayaccheti yadyogyaṃ manyase nṛpa .. 27 ..
16.338.d:
.. आपस्तंब उवाच .. ..
श्रमेण महताविष्टाः कैवर्त्ता दुःखजीविनः ..
मम मूल्यं प्रयच्छेति यद्योग्यं मन्यसे नृप .. 27 ..
16.338.m: Āpastamba said: / Overcome with great exertion are the fishermen who live by distress. / Pay my price, O king, whatever you deem suitable. 27

16.338.s:
.. nābhāga uvāca .. ..
sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyo dadāmyaham ..
nigrahākhyasya bhagavanyathāha brahmanaṃdanaḥ .. 28 ..
16.338.d:
.. नाभाग उवाच .. ..
सहस्राणां शतं मूल्यं निषादेभ्यो ददाम्यहम् ..
निग्रहाख्यस्य भगवन्यथाह ब्रह्मनंदनः .. 28 ..
16.338.m: Nābhāga said: / I give a hundred thousand as the price to the Niṣādas, / for the one called captive, O venerable one, just as the son of Brahmā says. 28

16.338.s:
.. āpastaṃba uvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ śatasahasraiśca niyamyaḥ pārthiva tvayā ..
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamamātyaiḥ saha ciṃtaya .. 29 ..
16.338.d:
.. आपस्तंब उवाच .. ..
नाहं शतसहस्रैश्च नियम्यः पार्थिव त्वया ..
सदृशं दीयतां मूल्यममात्यैः सह चिंतय .. 29 ..
16.338.m: Āpastamba said: / I am not to be evaluated by you, O king, with hundreds of thousands. / Let a suitable price be given; consider together with your ministers. 29

16.338.s:
.. nābhāga uvāca .. ..
koṭiḥ pradīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyo dvijottama ..
yadyetadapi te mūlyaṃ tato bhūyaḥ pradīyate .. 7.1.338.30 .. ..
16.338.d:
.. नाभाग उवाच .. ..
कोटिः प्रदीयतां मूल्यं निषादेभ्यो द्विजोत्तम ..
यद्येतदपि ते मूल्यं ततो भूयः प्रदीयते .. 7.1.338.30 .. ..
16.338.m: Nābhāga said: / Let a crore be given as the price to the Niṣādas, O best of the twice-born. / If even this is [not] your price, then more shall be given. 30

16.338.s:
āpastaṃba uvāca .. ..
nārhaṃ mūlyaṃ ca me koṭiradhikaṃ vāpi pārthiva ..
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ciṃtaya .. 31 ..
16.338.d:
आपस्तंब उवाच .. ..
नार्हं मूल्यं च मे कोटिरधिकं वापि पार्थिव ..
सदृशं दीयतां मूल्यं ब्राह्मणैः सह चिंतय .. 31 ..
16.338.m: Āpastamba said: / 'A crore or even more is not a worthy price for me, O king. / Let a fitting price be given; ponder it together with the brahmins.'

16.338.s:
.. nābhāga uvāca .. ..
arddharājyaṃ samastaṃ vā niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām ..
etanmūlyamahaṃ manye kiṃ vā'nyanmanyase dvija .. 32 ..
16.338.d:
.. नाभाग उवाच .. ..
अर्द्धराज्यं समस्तं वा निषादेभ्यः प्रदीयताम् ..
एतन्मूल्यमहं मन्ये किं वाऽन्यन्मन्यसे द्विज .. 32 ..
16.338.m: Nābhāga said: / 'Let half the kingdom or the whole of it be given to the Niṣādas. / This I consider the price, or what else do you think, O twice-born one?'

16.338.s:
.. āpastaṃba uvāca .. ..
ardharājyasamastaṃ vā nāhamarhāmi pārthiva ..
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamṛṣibhiḥ saha ciṃtaya .. 33 ..
16.338.d:
.. आपस्तंब उवाच .. ..
अर्धराज्यसमस्तं वा नाहमर्हामि पार्थिव ..
सदृशं दीयतां मूल्यमृषिभिः सह चिंतय .. 33 ..
16.338.m: Āpastamba said: / 'I am not worth half the kingdom or the whole, O king. / Let a fitting price be given; ponder it together with the seers.'

16.338.s:
maharṣestadvacaḥ śrutvā nābhāgaḥ sa viṣādavān ..
cintayāmāsa duḥkhārtaḥ sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ .. 34 ..
16.338.d:
महर्षेस्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा नाभागः स विषादवान् ..
चिन्तयामास दुःखार्तः सामात्यः सपुरोहितः .. 34 ..
16.338.m: Hearing those words of the great seer, Nābhāga was dejected; / afflicted with sorrow, he pondered together with his ministers and family priest.

16.338.s:
tataḥ kaścidṛṣistatra lomaśastu mahātapāḥ ..
nābhāgamabravīnmā bhaistoṣayiṣyāmi taṃ munim .. 35 ..
16.338.d:
ततः कश्चिदृषिस्तत्र लोमशस्तु महातपाः ..
नाभागमब्रवीन्मा भैस्तोषयिष्यामि तं मुनिम् .. 35 ..
16.338.m: Then a certain seer there, Lomaśa of great austerity, / spoke to Nābhāga: 'Do not fear, I shall satisfy that sage.'

16.338.s:
.. nābhāga uvāca .. ..
brūhi mūlyaṃ mahābhāga munerasya mahātmanaḥ ..
paritrāyasva māmasmātsajñātikulabāṃdhavam .. 36 ..
16.338.d:
.. नाभाग उवाच .. ..
ब्रूहि मूल्यं महाभाग मुनेरस्य महात्मनः ..
परित्रायस्व मामस्मात्सज्ञातिकुलबांधवम् .. 36 ..
16.338.m: Nābhāga said: / 'Declare the price of this great-souled sage, O fortunate one! / Deliver me, along with my kinsmen, clan, and relatives, from this [plight]!

16.338.s:
nirdahedbhagavānrudrastrailokyaṃ sacarācaram..
kiṃ punarmānuṣaṃ hīnamatyaṃtavi ṣayātmakam .. 37 ..
16.338.d:
निर्दहेद्भगवान्रुद्रस्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्..
किं पुनर्मानुषं हीनमत्यंतवि षयात्मकम् .. 37 ..
16.338.m: The Lord Rudra could burn up the three worlds, both moving and unmoving— / how much more a base human being, wholly given over to worldly objects!'

16.338.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca .. ..
tvamīḍyo hi mahārāja jagatpūjyo dvijottamaḥ ..
gāvaśca divyāstasmādgaurmūlyamamyai pradīyatām.. 39 ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ ..
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭaḥ provācedaṃ vacomunim .. 39 ..
16.338.d:
.. लोमश उवाच .. ..
त्वमीड्यो हि महाराज जगत्पूज्यो द्विजोत्तमः ..
गावश्च दिव्यास्तस्माद्गौर्मूल्यमम्यै प्रदीयताम्.. 39 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं राजा सामात्यः सपुरोहितः ..
हर्षेण महताविष्टः प्रोवाचेदं वचोमुनिम् .. 39 ..
16.338.m:
Lomaśa said: / 'You are to be praised, O great king, and the best of the twice-born is worthy of the world's worship; / and cows are divine. Therefore, let a cow be given as the price for him.'
Hearing that speech, the king, together with his ministers and priest, / was overcome with great joy and addressed these words to the sage:

16.338.s:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhagavankrīta eva na saṃśayaḥ ..
etadyogyatamaṃ mūlyaṃ bhavato munisattama .. 7.1.338.40 ..
16.338.d:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भगवन्क्रीत एव न संशयः ..
एतद्योग्यतमं मूल्यं भवतो मुनिसत्तम .. 7.1.338.40 ..
16.338.m: 'Rise, rise, Lord! You are indeed purchased, of this there is no doubt! / This is the most suitable price for you, O best of sages!'

16.338.s:
.. āpastaṃba uvāca .. ..
uttiṣṭhāmyeṣa suprītaḥ samyakkrīto'smi pārthiva ..
gobhyo mūlyaṃ na paśyāmi pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhuvi .. 41 ..
16.338.d:
.. आपस्तंब उवाच .. ..
उत्तिष्ठाम्येष सुप्रीतः सम्यक्क्रीतोऽस्मि पार्थिव ..
गोभ्यो मूल्यं न पश्यामि पवित्रं परमं भुवि .. 41 ..
16.338.m: Āpastamba said: / 'Here I rise well pleased; I am rightly purchased, O king! / On earth I see no price equal to cows, the supreme purifier.

16.338.s:
gāvaḥ pradakṣiṇīkāryāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ ..
maṃgalāyatanaṃ devyaḥ sṛṣṭā hyetāḥ svayaṃbhuvā.. .. 42 ..
16.338.d:
गावः प्रदक्षिणीकार्याः पूजनीयाश्च नित्यशः ..
मंगलायतनं देव्यः सृष्टा ह्येताः स्वयंभुवा.. .. 42 ..
16.338.m: Cows should be circumambulated and worshipped constantly. / Goddesses and abodes of auspiciousness, they were created by the self-manifest [Brahmā].

16.338.s:
agnyagārāṇi viprāṇāṃ devatāyatanāni ca ..
yadgomayena śuddhyaṃti kiṃbhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ ..43..
16.338.d:
अग्न्यगाराणि विप्राणां देवतायतनानि च ..
यद्गोमयेन शुद्ध्यंति किंभूतमधिकं ततः ..43..
16.338.m: Since the fire-sanctuaries of brahmins and the shrines of the deities / are purified by cow-dung, what entity is greater than that?

16.338.s:
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpistathaiva ca ..
gavāṃ paṃca pavitrāṇi punaṃti sakalaṃ jagat ..44..
16.338.d:
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिस्तथैव च ..
गवां पंच पवित्राणि पुनंति सकलं जगत् ..44..
16.338.m: Cow-urine, cow-dung, milk, curd, and ghee— / the five purifiers from cows purify the entire world.

16.338.s:
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca ..
gāvo me hradaye caiva gavāṃ madhye vasāmyahama ..45..
16.338.d:
गावो ममाग्रतो नित्यं गावः पृष्ठत एव च ..
गावो मे ह्रदये चैव गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम ..45..
16.338.m: Cows in front of me always, cows behind me, / cows in my heart, and I live amidst cows.

16.338.s:
evaṃ japannaro maṃtraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 46 ..
16.338.d:
एवं जपन्नरो मंत्रं त्रिसंध्यं नियतः शुचिः ..
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति .. 46 ..
16.338.m: A man chanting this mantra thus at the three twilights, self-restrained and pure, / is freed from all sins and goes to the heavenly world.

16.338.s:
tṛṇāhāraparā gāvaḥ karttavyā bhaktito'nvaham..
akṛtvā svayamāhāraṃ kurvanprāpnoti durgatim .. 47 ..
16.338.d:
तृणाहारपरा गावः कर्त्तव्या भक्तितोऽन्वहम्..
अकृत्वा स्वयमाहारं कुर्वन्प्राप्नोति दुर्गतिम् .. 47 ..
16.338.m: Cows should daily be provided with grass out of devotion. / He who takes food himself without doing so meets a wretched fate.

16.338.s:
tenāgnayo hutāḥ samyakpitaraścāpi tarpitāḥ ..
devāśca pūjitāstena yo dadāti gavāhnikam..48..
16.338.d:
तेनाग्नयो हुताः सम्यक्पितरश्चापि तर्पिताः ..
देवाश्च पूजितास्तेन यो ददाति गवाह्निकम्..48..
16.338.m: By him fires are rightly offered into, the ancestors are propitiated, / and the deities are worshipped—by him who offers daily food to cows.

16.338.s:
mantraḥ ..
saurabheyī jagatpūjyā devī viṣṇupade sthitā ..
sarvameva mayā dattaṃ pratīcchatu sutoṣitā..49..
16.338.d:
मन्त्रः ..
सौरभेयी जगत्पूज्या देवी विष्णुपदे स्थिता ..
सर्वमेव मया दत्तं प्रतीच्छतु सुतोषिता..49..
16.338.m: The mantra: / "O daughter of Surabhī, goddess worshipped by the world, abiding in Viṣṇu's realm, / highly pleased, may you accept everything offered by me!"

16.338.s:
rakṣaṇādbālaputrāṇāṃ gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanāttathā ..
kṣīṇārtarakṣaṇāccaiva naraḥ svarge mahīyate . 7.1.338.50 ..
16.338.d:
रक्षणाद्बालपुत्राणां गवां कण्डूयनात्तथा ..
क्षीणार्तरक्षणाच्चैव नरः स्वर्गे महीयते . 7.1.338.50 ..
16.338.m: By protecting calves, by scratching cows, / and by protecting the emaciated and distressed, a man is honoured in heaven.

16.338.s:
ādirgāvo hi martyasya madhye cāṃte prakīrtitāḥ ..
rakṣaṃti tāstu devānāṃ kṣīrājyamamṛtaṃ sadā .. 51 ..
16.338.d:
आदिर्गावो हि मर्त्यस्य मध्ये चांते प्रकीर्तिताः ..
रक्षंति तास्तु देवानां क्षीराज्यममृतं सदा .. 51 ..
16.338.m: Cows are declared to be the mortal's beginning, middle, and end; / and they always protect the nectar of milk and ghee for the deities.

16.338.s:
tasmādgāvaḥ pradātavyāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ ..
svargasya saṃgamā hyetāḥ sopānamiva nirmitāḥ .. 52 ..
16.338.d:
तस्माद्गावः प्रदातव्याः पूजनीयाश्च नित्यशः ..
स्वर्गस्य संगमा ह्येताः सोपानमिव निर्मिताः .. 52 ..
16.338.m: Therefore cows should be gifted and worshipped constantly; / they are constructed as it were as a stairway to reach heaven.'

16.338.s:
etacchrutvā niṣādāste gavāṃ māhātmyamutta mam ..
praṇipatya mahātmānamāpastaṃbamathābruvan .. 53 ..
16.338.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा निषादास्ते गवां माहात्म्यमुत्त मम् ..
प्रणिपत्य महात्मानमापस्तंबमथाब्रुवन् .. 53 ..
16.338.m: Hearing this supreme greatness of cows, those Niṣādas, / having bowed down to the great-souled Āpastamba, then spoke:

16.338.s:
.. niṣādā ūcuḥ .. ..
saṃbhāṣo darśanaṃ sparśaḥ kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā ..
pāvanāni kilaitāni sādhūnāmiti ca śrutam .. 54 ..
16.338.d:
.. निषादा ऊचुः .. ..
संभाषो दर्शनं स्पर्शः कीर्तनं स्मरणं तथा ..
पावनानि किलैतानि साधूनामिति च श्रुतम् .. 54 ..
16.338.m: The Niṣādas said: / 'Conversation, darśana, touch, praise, and remembrance— / these are indeed purifying in the case of the virtuous: so have we heard.

16.338.s:
saṃbhāṣo darśanaṃ caiva sahāsmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tvayā ..
kuruṣvānugrahaṃ tasmādgaureṣā pratigṛhyatām .. 55 ..
16.338.d:
संभाषो दर्शनं चैव सहास्माभिः कृतं त्वया ..
कुरुष्वानुग्रहं तस्माद्गौरेषा प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 55 ..
16.338.m: Both conversation and darśana have been shared by you with us; / therefore grant your grace: let this cow be taken back [by the king].'

16.338.s:
.. āpastaṃba uvāca .. ..
etā vaḥ pratigṛhṇāmi gāṃ yūyaṃ muktakilviṣāḥ ..
niṣādā gacchata svargaṃ saha matsyairjaloddhṛtaiḥ ..56..
16.338.d:
.. आपस्तंब उवाच .. ..
एता वः प्रतिगृह्णामि गां यूयं मुक्तकिल्विषाः ..
निषादा गच्छत स्वर्गं सह मत्स्यैर्जलोद्धृतैः ..56..
16.338.m: Āpastamba said: / 'I accept this cow on your behalf; freed from taint, / O Niṣādas, go to heaven along with the fish taken from the water!

16.338.s:
prāṇināṃ prītimutpādya nindite nāpi karmaṇā ..
narakaṃ yadi paśyāmi vatsyāmi svarga eva tat .. 57 ..
16.338.d:
प्राणिनां प्रीतिमुत्पाद्य निन्दिते नापि कर्मणा ..
नरकं यदि पश्यामि वत्स्यामि स्वर्ग एव तत् .. 57 ..
16.338.m: If I see hell through producing delight in living beings / even by a censured act, that will indeed be living in heaven.

16.338.s:
yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiñcinmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ ..
kṛtaṃ syāttena duḥkhārtāḥ sarve yāṃtu śubhāṃ gatim .. 58 ..
16.338.d:
यन्मया सुकृतं किञ्चिन्मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः ..
कृतं स्यात्तेन दुःखार्ताः सर्वे यांतु शुभां गतिम् .. 58 ..
16.338.m: Whatever good deed may have been done by me through acts of mind, speech, or body— / by that, may all who are afflicted by suffering go to an auspicious destination!'

16.338.s:
tatastasya prasādena maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ..
niṣādāstena vākyena saha matsyairdivaṃ gatāḥ .. 59 ..
16.338.d:
ततस्तस्य प्रसादेन महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः ..
निषादास्तेन वाक्येन सह मत्स्यैर्दिवं गताः .. 59 ..
16.338.m: Then, by the grace of that great seer of cultivated soul, / through his word, the Niṣādas went to heaven along with the fish.

16.338.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā vrajataḥ svargaṃ samatsyānmatsyajīvinaḥ ..
sāmātyabhṛtyo nṛpatirvismayādidamabravīt .. 7.1.338.60 ..
16.338.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा व्रजतः स्वर्गं समत्स्यान्मत्स्यजीविनः ..
सामात्यभृत्यो नृपतिर्विस्मयादिदमब्रवीत् .. 7.1.338.60 ..
16.338.m: Seeing those who lived on fish departing for heaven together with the fish, / the king, with his ministers and servants, said this in astonishment:

16.338.s:
sevyāḥ śreyo'rthibhiḥ santaḥ puṇyatīrthe jalopamāḥ ..
kṣaṇo pāsanamapyatra na yeṣāṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet .. 61 ..
16.338.d:
सेव्याः श्रेयोऽर्थिभिः सन्तः पुण्यतीर्थे जलोपमाः ..
क्षणो पासनमप्यत्र न येषां निष्फलं भवेत् .. 61 ..
16.338.m: 'The virtuous, like water at a sacred ford, should be served by those seeking welfare; / even a moment's attendance upon them here never becomes fruitless.

16.338.s:
sadbhiḥ saha sadāsīta sadbhiḥ kurvīta satkathām ..
satāṃ vratena varteta nāsadbhiḥ kiñcidācaret .. 62 ..
16.338.d:
सद्भिः सह सदासीत सद्भिः कुर्वीत सत्कथाम् ..
सतां व्रतेन वर्तेत नासद्भिः किञ्चिदाचरेत् .. 62 ..
16.338.m: One should always sit with the good; with the good one should engage in virtuous talk; / one should conduct oneself by the observance of the good; with the wicked one should have no dealings.

16.338.s:
satāṃ samāgamādete samatsyā matsyajīvinaḥ ..
triviṣṭapamanuprāptā narāḥ puṇyakṛto yathā .. 63 ..
16.338.d:
सतां समागमादेते समत्स्या मत्स्यजीविनः ..
त्रिविष्टपमनुप्राप्ता नराः पुण्यकृतो यथा .. 63 ..
16.338.m: Through association with the good, these fish-catchers, together with the fish, / have attained heaven just like men who perform meritorious deeds.'

16.338.s:
āpastaṃbo munistatra lomaśaśca mahāmanāḥ ..
varaistaṃ vividhairiṣṭaiśchaṃdayāmāsaturnṛpam.. 64 ..
16.338.d:
आपस्तंबो मुनिस्तत्र लोमशश्च महामनाः ..
वरैस्तं विविधैरिष्टैश्छंदयामासतुर्नृपम्.. 64 ..
16.338.m: There the sage Āpastamba and high-minded Lomaśa / gratified that king with various boons he desired.

16.338.s:
tataḥ sa varayāmāsa dharmabuddhiṃ sudurlabhām ..
tatheti coktvā tau prītyā taṃ nṛpaṃ vai śaśaṃsatuḥ .. 65 ..
16.338.d:
ततः स वरयामास धर्मबुद्धिं सुदुर्लभाम् ..
तथेति चोक्त्वा तौ प्रीत्या तं नृपं वै शशंसतुः .. 65 ..
16.338.m: Then he chose an intellect devoted to dharma, which is very hard to obtain. / Saying, 'So be it,' the two of them praised that king with affection:

16.338.s:
aho dhanyo'si rājendra yatte dharmaparā matiḥ ..
dharmaḥ sudurlabhaḥ puṃsāṃ viśeṣeṇa mahīkṣitām .. 66 ..
16.338.d:
अहो धन्योऽसि राजेन्द्र यत्ते धर्मपरा मतिः ..
धर्मः सुदुर्लभः पुंसां विशेषेण महीक्षिताम् .. 66 ..
16.338.m: 'Ah, fortunate are you, O king of kings, that your mind is devoted to dharma! / Dharma is very difficult to obtain for men, especially for rulers of the earth.

16.338.s:
yadi rājā madāviṣṭaḥ svadharmaṃ na pari tyajet ..
tato jagati kastasmātpumānabhyadhiko bhavet .. 67 ..
16.338.d:
यदि राजा मदाविष्टः स्वधर्मं न परि त्यजेत् ..
ततो जगति कस्तस्मात्पुमानभ्यधिको भवेत् .. 67 ..
16.338.m: If a king seized by pride does not abandon his own duty, / then what man in the world could be superior to him?

16.338.s:
dhruvaṃ janma sadā rājñāṃ mohaścāpi sadā dhruvaḥ ..
mohāddhruvaśca narako rājyaṃ nindantyato budhāḥ .. 68 ..
16.338.d:
ध्रुवं जन्म सदा राज्ञां मोहश्चापि सदा ध्रुवः ..
मोहाद्ध्रुवश्च नरको राज्यं निन्दन्त्यतो बुधाः .. 68 ..
16.338.m: Certain is rebirth for kings always, and delusion too is always certain; / and from delusion, hell is certain; therefore the wise disparage kingship.

16.338.s:
rājyaṃ hi bahu manyaṃte narā viṣayalolupāḥ ..
manīṣiṇastu paśyanti tadeva narakopamam .. 69 ..
16.338.d:
राज्यं हि बहु मन्यंते नरा विषयलोलुपाः ..
मनीषिणस्तु पश्यन्ति तदेव नरकोपमम् .. 69 ..
16.338.m: Men greedy for sensory objects indeed value kingship highly, / but the wise see that very thing as resembling hell.

16.338.s:
tasmāllokadvayadhvaṃsī na karttavyo madastvayā ..
yadīcchasi mahārāja śāśvatīṃ gatimātmanaḥ .. 7.1.338.70 ..
16.338.d:
तस्माल्लोकद्वयध्वंसी न कर्त्तव्यो मदस्त्वया ..
यदीच्छसि महाराज शाश्वतीं गतिमात्मनः .. 7.1.338.70 ..
16.338.m: Therefore pride, which destroys both worlds, must not be indulged by you, / if you desire an eternal destination for yourself, O great king.'

16.338.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā tau mahātmānau jagmatuḥ svaṃ svamāśramam ..
nābhāgo'pi varaṃ labdhvā prahṛṣṭaḥ prāviśatpuram .. 71 ..
16.338.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा तौ महात्मानौ जग्मतुः स्वं स्वमाश्रमम् ..
नाभागोऽपि वरं लब्ध्वा प्रहृष्टः प्राविशत्पुरम् .. 71 ..
16.338.m: Īśvara said: / Having spoken thus, the two great-souled ones went each to his own hermitage. / Nābhāga too, having obtained the boon, entered his city overjoyed.

16.338.s:
etatte kathitaṃ devi prabhāvaṃ devikodbhavam ..
ṛṣiṇā sthāpitaścāpi bhavo jāle śvarastadā .. 72 ..
16.338.d:
एतत्ते कथितं देवि प्रभावं देविकोद्भवम् ..
ऋषिणा स्थापितश्चापि भवो जाले श्वरस्तदा .. 72 ..
16.338.m: This glory originating from the Devikā has been told to you, O goddess; / and Bhava [as] Jāleśvara was also established by the seer at that time.

16.338.s:
jāle nipatito yasmāddāśānāmṛṣisattamaḥ ..
jāleśvareti nāmāsau vikhyātaḥ pṛthivītale .. 73 ..
16.338.d:
जाले निपतितो यस्माद्दाशानामृषिसत्तमः ..
जालेश्वरेति नामासौ विख्यातः पृथिवीतले .. 73 ..
16.338.m: Because the best of seers fell into the net of fishermen, / he is celebrated upon the surface of the earth under the name Jāleśvara. 73

16.338.s:
tatra snātvā mahādevi jāleśvarasamarcanāt ..
āpastaṃbaśca nābhāgo niṣādā matsyajīvinaḥ .. 74 ..
16.338.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि जालेश्वरसमर्चनात् ..
आपस्तंबश्च नाभागो निषादा मत्स्यजीविनः .. 74 ..
16.338.m: Having bathed there, O great goddess, from worshipping Jāleśvara, / Āpastamba, Nābhāga, and the fishermen who lived on fish, 74

16.338.s:
matsyaiḥ saha gatāḥ svargaṃ devikāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ..
caitrasyaiva tu māsasya śuklapakṣe trayodaśīm .. 75 ..
16.338.d:
मत्स्यैः सह गताः स्वर्गं देविकायाः प्रभावतः ..
चैत्रस्यैव तु मासस्य शुक्लपक्षे त्रयोदशीम् .. 75 ..
16.338.m: went to heaven along with the fish, by the power of Devikā. / On the thirteenth day of the bright half of the month of Caitra, 75

16.338.s:
dadyātpiṇḍaṃ pitṛbhyo yastasyāṃto naiva vidyate ..
godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
śrotavyaṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ draṣṭavyo jālakeśvaraḥ .. 76 ..
16.338.d:
दद्यात्पिण्डं पितृभ्यो यस्तस्यांतो नैव विद्यते ..
गोदानं तत्र देयं तु ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
श्रोतव्यं चैव माहात्म्यं द्रष्टव्यो जालकेश्वरः .. 76 ..
16.338.m: whoever offers a funeral cake to the ancestors has no end [to the merit]. / A gift of a cow should be given there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas; / and the māhātmya should be heard, and Jālakeśvara should be seen. 76

16.338.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikā nadīmāhātmye jāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 338 .. cha ..
16.338.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देविका नदीमाहात्म्ये जालेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टात्रिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 338 .. छ ..
16.338.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirty-eighth chapter, titled 'Description of the māhātmya of Jāleśvara' in the māhātmya of the river Devikā, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 338

16.339.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kūpaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
devikāyāstaṭe ramye huṃkāreṇaiva pūryate .. 1 ..
16.339.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कूपं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
देविकायास्तटे रम्ये हुंकारेणैव पूर्यते .. 1 ..
16.339.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the well renowned in the three worlds / on the charming bank of the Devikā, which fills up solely by the sound 'huṃ'. 1

16.339.s:
tato'dhastātpunaryāti salilaṃ tatra bhāmini ..
taṇḍīnāma purā prokto devikātaṭamāsthitaḥ .. 2 ..
16.339.d:
ततोऽधस्तात्पुनर्याति सलिलं तत्र भामिनि ..
तण्डीनाम पुरा प्रोक्तो देविकातटमास्थितः .. 2 ..
16.339.m: Then, O spirited lady, the water goes back down below. / Formerly, one named Taṇḍī was settled on the bank of the Devikā; 2

16.339.s:
tapastepe mahādevi śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya tasmindeśe varānane .. 3 ..
16.339.d:
तपस्तेपे महादेवि शिवभक्तिपरायणः ..
तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य तस्मिन्देशे वरानने .. 3 ..
16.339.m: devoted to devotion to Śiva, he performed austerity, O great goddess. / As he was thus performing austerity in that region, O fair-faced one, 3

16.339.s:
ājagāma mṛgo vṛddhastaṃ deśamandha dṛkpriye ..
sa papāta mahāgarte agādhe jalavarjite .. 4 ..
16.339.d:
आजगाम मृगो वृद्धस्तं देशमन्ध दृक्प्रिये ..
स पपात महागर्ते अगाधे जलवर्जिते .. 4 ..
16.339.m: an aged deer, blind of eye, came to that place, O beloved; / it fell into a vast, fathomless pit devoid of water. 4

16.339.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayāviṣṭaḥ sa munirmaunamāsthitaḥ ..
huṃkāraṃ kurute tatra bhūyobhūyaśca bhāmini .. 5 ..
16.339.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा कृपयाविष्टः स मुनिर्मौनमास्थितः ..
हुंकारं कुरुते तत्र भूयोभूयश्च भामिनि .. 5 ..
16.339.m: Seeing it, that sage, filled with compassion, maintained silence / and uttered the sound 'huṃ' there again and again, O spirited lady. 5

16.339.s:
atha huṃkāraśabdena tasya gartaḥ prapūritaḥ ..
tato mṛgo viniṣkrāṃtaḥ kṛcchreṇa salilātpriye .. 6 ..
16.339.d:
अथ हुंकारशब्देन तस्य गर्तः प्रपूरितः ..
ततो मृगो विनिष्क्रांतः कृच्छ्रेण सलिलात्प्रिये .. 6 ..
16.339.m: Then, by the sound 'huṃ', that pit was filled up; / and then, O beloved, the deer came out with difficulty from the water. 6

16.339.s:
mānuṣaṃ rūpamāśritya tamṛṣiṃ paryapṛcchata ..
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā kāmyadaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam .. 7 ..
16.339.d:
मानुषं रूपमाश्रित्य तमृषिं पर्यपृच्छत ..
विस्मयं परमं गत्वा काम्यदं कर्मणः फलम् .. 7 ..
16.339.m: Assuming a human form, it questioned that seer, / having experienced the greatest wonder, as to the fruit of the action that bestows wishes: 7

16.339.s:
mṛgatve patitaścātra naro bhūtvā vinirgataḥ ..
so'bravīttasya māhātmyaṃ salilasya dvijottamaḥ .. 8 ..
16.339.d:
मृगत्वे पतितश्चात्र नरो भूत्वा विनिर्गतः ..
सोऽब्रवीत्तस्य माहात्म्यं सलिलस्य द्विजोत्तमः .. 8 ..
16.339.m: "I had fallen in the state of a deer, and have come forth having become a human!" / That best of the twice-born declared the māhātmya of that water: 8

16.339.s:
ato'haṃ naratāṃ prāpto nānyadastīha kāraṇam ..
tatastatsalilaṃ bhūyaḥ praviṣṭaṃ dharaṇītale .. 9 ..
16.339.d:
अतोऽहं नरतां प्राप्तो नान्यदस्तीह कारणम् ..
ततस्तत्सलिलं भूयः प्रविष्टं धरणीतले .. 9 ..
16.339.m: "From this have I attained human nature; there is no other reason here." / Then that water entered once more into the depths of the earth. 9

16.339.s:
tato huṃkṛtavānbhūyaḥ sa ṛṣiḥ kautukānvitaḥ ..
āpūritaḥ punaḥ kūpaḥ salilena purā yathā .. 7.1.339.10 ..
16.339.d:
ततो हुंकृतवान्भूयः स ऋषिः कौतुकान्वितः ..
आपूरितः पुनः कूपः सलिलेन पुरा यथा .. 7.1.339.10 ..
16.339.m: Then, filled with curiosity, that seer uttered 'huṃ' again; / and the well was once more filled with water just as before. 7.1.339.10

16.339.s:
tataḥ sa kṛtavānsnānaṃ tathā ca pitṛtarpaṇam..
matvā tīrthavaraṃ tatra tataḥ prāptaḥ parāṃ gatim .. 11 ..
16.339.d:
ततः स कृतवान्स्नानं तथा च पितृतर्पणम्..
मत्वा तीर्थवरं तत्र ततः प्राप्तः परां गतिम् .. 11 ..
16.339.m: Then he performed ritual ablution and also the libation to the ancestors; / considering it an excellent sacred ford, he attained the supreme state. 11

16.339.s:
adyāpi huṃkṛte tasminsalilaughaḥ pravartate ..
tatra gatvā naro bhaktyā api pāparato'pi yaḥ .. 12 ..
16.339.d:
अद्यापि हुंकृते तस्मिन्सलिलौघः प्रवर्तते ..
तत्र गत्वा नरो भक्त्या अपि पापरतोऽपि यः .. 12 ..
16.339.m: Even today, when 'huṃ' is uttered, a flood of water surges forth. / A man who goes there with devotion, even if addicted to sin, 12

16.339.s:
na mānuṣyaṃ punarjanma prāpnoti jagatītale ..
tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ .. 13 ..
16.339.d:
न मानुष्यं पुनर्जन्म प्राप्नोति जगतीतले ..
तत्र स्नात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः .. 13 ..
16.339.m: does not obtain a rebirth as a human on the earth's surface. / Having bathed there and become purified, the man who performs a ancestral offering (śrāddha) 13

16.339.s:
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ pitṛloke mahīyate ..
kulāni tārayetsapta atītā'nāgatāni ca .. 14 ..
16.339.d:
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः पितृलोके महीयते ..
कुलानि तारयेत्सप्त अतीताऽनागतानि च .. 14 ..
16.339.m: is freed from all sins and honored in the world of the ancestors; / he delivers seven ancestral lines, both past and future. 14

16.339.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmye huṃkārakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 339 .. .. cha ..
16.339.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देविकामाहात्म्ये हुंकारकूपमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 339 .. .. छ ..
16.339.m: Thus ends the three hundred and thirty-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the māhātmya of Huṃkārakūpa' in the māhātmya of Devikā, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 339

16.340.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tatra sthāne tu saṃsthitam..
caṇḍīśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.340.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तत्र स्थाने तु संस्थितम्..
चण्डीश्वरं महालिंगं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.340.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Caṇḍīśvara, the great liṅga / situated in that place, the destroyer of all sins. 1

16.340.s:
tatra śuklacaturddaśyāṃ kārtike māsi bhāmini ..
upavāsaparo bhūtvā yaḥ karoti prajāgaram ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 2 ..
16.340.d:
तत्र शुक्लचतुर्द्दश्यां कार्तिके मासि भामिनि ..
उपवासपरो भूत्वा यः करोति प्रजागरम् ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 2 ..
16.340.m: There, on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Kārttika, O spirited lady, / whoever observes a fast and keeps a vigil / goes to the supreme abode where the divine Maheśvara dwells. 2

16.340.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmye caṇḍīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 340 ..
16.340.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देविकामाहात्म्ये चण्डीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 340 ..
16.340.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fortieth chapter, titled 'Description of the māhātmya of Caṇḍīśvara' in the māhātmya of Devikā, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 340

16.341.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
āśāpūraṃ tato gacchedvighnarājamakalmaṣam ..
śaśibhūṣaṇa vāyavye saṃsthitaṃ vighnanāśanam..
āśāṃ pūrayate yasmāttenāśāpūrakaḥ smṛtaḥ ..1 ..
16.341.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आशापूरं ततो गच्छेद्विघ्नराजमकल्मषम् ..
शशिभूषण वायव्ये संस्थितं विघ्ननाशनम्..
आशां पूरयते यस्मात्तेनाशापूरकः स्मृतः ..1 ..
16.341.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go to the blameless Vighnarāja Āśāpūra, / situated to the north-west of Śaśibhūṣaṇa, the destroyer of obstacles; / because he fulfills desires, he is called Āśāpūraka. 1

16.341.s:
yatra rāmeṇa deveśi sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca ..
samārādhya ca vighneśaṃ prāptaṃ kāmamabhīpsitam.. 2 ..
16.341.d:
यत्र रामेण देवेशि सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च ..
समाराध्य च विघ्नेशं प्राप्तं काममभीप्सितम्.. 2 ..
16.341.m: Where, having worshipped the lord of obstacles, O ruler of gods, / Rāma, together with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa, obtained their desired wish; 2

16.341.s:
yatra caṃdramasā devi samārādhya gaṇādhipam ..
labdhaṃ tadvāṃchitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvakuṣṭhavināśanam .. 3 ..
16.341.d:
यत्र चंद्रमसा देवि समाराध्य गणाधिपम् ..
लब्धं तद्वांछितं पूर्वं सर्वकुष्ठविनाशनम् .. 3 ..
16.341.m: where, O goddess, having worshipped the leader of the gaṇas, the Moon / obtained of old his desired wish: the destruction of all leprosy. 3

16.341.s:
caturthyāṃ śuklapakṣe ca māsi bhādrapade tathā ..
tatra saṃpūjya deveśaṃ modakairbhojayeddvijān .. 4 ..
16.341.d:
चतुर्थ्यां शुक्लपक्षे च मासि भाद्रपदे तथा ..
तत्र संपूज्य देवेशं मोदकैर्भोजयेद्द्विजान् .. 4 ..
16.341.m: On the fourth day in the bright half of the month of Bhādrapada, / having worshipped the lord of gods there, one should feed the twice-born with sweetmeats (modakas). 4

16.341.s:
vāñchitāṃ labhate siddhiṃ vighnarājaprasādataḥ ..
kṣetrasyāsya mahādevi rakṣārthaṃ tu mayā purā .. 5 ..
16.341.d:
वाञ्छितां लभते सिद्धिं विघ्नराजप्रसादतः ..
क्षेत्रस्यास्य महादेवि रक्षार्थं तु मया पुरा .. 5 ..
16.341.m: By the grace of the king of obstacles, one obtains the desired perfection (siddhi). / For the protection of this sacred field, O great goddess, by me of old, 5
then was the destroyer of obstacles appointed, O ruler of gods, for travelers. 6

16.341.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya āśāpūravighnarāja māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatśariṃśaduttara triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 341 ..
16.341.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य आशापूरविघ्नराज माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकचत्शरिंशदुत्तर त्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 341 ..
16.341.m: Thus ends the three hundred and forty-first chapter, titled 'Description of the māhātmya of Āśāpūravighnarāja' in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 341

16.342.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasya dakṣiṇanairṛtye nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ devi svayaṃ somapratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.342.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्य दक्षिणनैरृत्ये नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
लिंगं पापहरं देवि स्वयं सोमप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.342.m: Īśvara said: / To the south-south-west of it, established not very far away, / is the liṅga that removes sins, O goddess, installed by Soma himself. 1

16.342.s:
tatraivāmṛtakuṇḍaṃ tu kalākuṇḍaṃ tu tatsmṛtam ..
tatra snātvā tu caṃdreśaṃ yo naraḥ pūjayiṣyati .. 2 ..
16.342.d:
तत्रैवामृतकुण्डं तु कलाकुण्डं तु तत्स्मृतम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा तु चंद्रेशं यो नरः पूजयिष्यति .. 2 ..
16.342.m: Right there is the Amṛtakuṇḍa, which is known as Kalākuṇḍa; / having bathed there, whatever man worships Candreśa, 2

16.342.s:
sa tu varṣasahasrasya tapaḥphalamavāpsyati ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ devi taḍāgaṃ caṃdranirmitam .. 3 ..
16.342.d:
स तु वर्षसहस्रस्य तपःफलमवाप्स्यति ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं देवि तडागं चंद्रनिर्मितम् .. 3 ..
16.342.m: he will obtain the fruit of a thousand years of austerity. / Right there, O goddess, lies the pool created by the Moon, 3

16.342.s:
dhanuḥṣoḍaśavistāraṃ caṃdreśātpūrvapaścime ..
tatpūrvaṃ te samākhyātaṃ muktidānādipūrvakam .. 4 ..
16.342.d:
धनुःषोडशविस्तारं चंद्रेशात्पूर्वपश्चिमे ..
तत्पूर्वं ते समाख्यातं मुक्तिदानादिपूर्वकम् .. 4 ..
16.342.m: sixteen bows in breadth, to the east and west of Candreśa; / that has been told to you previously, beginning with the bestowing of liberation. 4

16.342.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya āśāpūramāhātmye caṃdreśvarakalākuṇḍatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 342 .. ..
16.342.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य आशापूरमाहात्म्ये चंद्रेश्वरकलाकुण्डतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विचत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 342 .. ..
16.342.m: Thus ends the three hundred and forty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the māhātmya of the sacred ford of Candreśvara and Kalākuṇḍa' in the māhātmya of Āśāpūra, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 342

16.343.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kapileśvaramuttamam ..
śīrābhūṣaṇapūrveṇa koṭitīrthācca paścime ..1 ..
16.343.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कपिलेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
शीराभूषणपूर्वेण कोटितीर्थाच्च पश्चिमे ..1 ..
16.343.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Kapileśvara, / to the east of Śīrābhūṣaṇa and to the west of Koṭītīrtha, 1

16.343.s:
jaradgaveśāddakṣiṇe samudrottaratastathā ..
etadvai kāpilaṃ kṣetraṃ nāpuṇyaiḥ prāpyate naraiḥ .. 2 ..
16.343.d:
जरद्गवेशाद्दक्षिणे समुद्रोत्तरतस्तथा ..
एतद्वै कापिलं क्षेत्रं नापुण्यैः प्राप्यते नरैः .. 2 ..
16.343.m: to the south of Jaradgaveśa and north of the ocean; / this Kāpila sacred field is indeed not attained by men devoid of merit. 2

16.343.s:
kapilena purā devi yatra taptaṃ tapo mahat ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram .. 3 ..
16.343.d:
कपिलेन पुरा देवि यत्र तप्तं तपो महत् ..
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
16.343.m: Where, O goddess, Kapila formerly performed great austerity, / having installed Maheśvara, for more than ten thousand years.

16.343.s:
samāhūtā tatra devī kapiladhārā mahānadī ..
samudramadhye sā'dyāpi puṇyavadbhiḥ pradṛśyate .. 4 ..
16.343.d:
समाहूता तत्र देवी कपिलधारा महानदी ..
समुद्रमध्ये साऽद्यापि पुण्यवद्भिः प्रदृश्यते .. 4 ..
16.343.m: There the divine great river Kapiladhārā was invoked; / even today it is seen amidst the ocean by meritorious people.

16.343.s:
tatra snātvā mahādevi kapilāṣaṣṭhyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
kapilāṃ dāpayettatra gokoṭiphalabhāgbhavet .. 5 ..
16.343.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि कपिलाषष्ठ्यां विशेषतः ..
कपिलां दापयेत्तत्र गोकोटिफलभाग्भवेत् .. 5 ..
16.343.m: Having bathed there, O great goddess, especially on Kapilāṣaṣṭhī, / one should give a brown cow there; one becomes a partaker of the fruit of ten million cows.

16.343.s:
sarveṣāṃ caiva pāpānāṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam ..
kapileśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya kanyākoṭiphalaṃ labhet .. 6 ..
16.343.d:
सर्वेषां चैव पापानां प्रायश्चित्तमिदं स्मृतम् ..
कपिलेश्वरं तु संपूज्य कन्याकोटिफलं लभेत् .. 6 ..
16.343.m: And this is remembered as an expiation for all sins; / having worshipped Kapileśvara, one obtains the fruit of [giving] ten million maidens.

16.343.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
āścaryaṃ mama deveśa kapilaṣaṣṭhyā maheśvara ..
vidhānaṃ śrotumicchāmi dānamantrādi pūrvakam .. 7 ..
16.343.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
आश्चर्यं मम देवेश कपिलषष्ठ्या महेश्वर ..
विधानं श्रोतुमिच्छामि दानमन्त्रादि पूर्वकम् .. 7 ..
16.343.m:
The goddess said:
Great is my wonder, O Lord of gods, O Maheśvara, regarding Kapilāṣaṣṭhī; / I wish to hear the prescribed procedure, beginning with the mantras for gifts.

16.343.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
janmajīvitamadhye tu yadyekā labhyate naraiḥ ..
saṃyogayuktā sā ṣaṣṭhī tatkiṃ devi bravīmyaham .. 8 ..
16.343.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
जन्मजीवितमध्ये तु यद्येका लभ्यते नरैः ..
संयोगयुक्ता सा षष्ठी तत्किं देवि ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 8 ..
16.343.m:
Īśvara said:
If in the course of a lifetime even one such sixth day [of the lunar fortnight] is attained by men, / endowed with [all] the conjunctions, what can I say, O goddess?

16.343.s:
prauṣṭhapadyasite pakṣe ṣaṣṭhyāmaṃgārako yadi ..
vyatīpātaśca rohiṇyāṃ sā ṣaṣṭhī kapilā smṛtā ..9..
16.343.d:
प्रौष्ठपद्यसिते पक्षे षष्ठ्यामंगारको यदि ..
व्यतीपातश्च रोहिण्यां सा षष्ठी कपिला स्मृता ..9..
16.343.m: In the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, if the sixth day falls on a Tuesday, / with Vyatīpāta and under Rohiṇī, that sixth day is remembered as Kapilā.

16.343.s:
tatra kṣetre naraḥ snātvā athavārkasthale śubhe ..
mṛdā śukla tilaiścaiva kapilāsaṃgame śubhe .. 7.1.343.10 ..
16.343.d:
तत्र क्षेत्रे नरः स्नात्वा अथवार्कस्थले शुभे ..
मृदा शुक्ल तिलैश्चैव कपिलासंगमे शुभे .. 7.1.343.10 ..
16.343.m: Having bathed in that sacred field, or at the auspicious Arkasthala, / with clay and white sesame seeds, at the auspicious confluence of Kapilā,

16.343.s:
kṛtasnānajapaḥ paścātsūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet ..
raktacaṃdanatoyena karavīrayutena ca ..
kṛtvārghapātraṃ śirasi maṃtreṇānena dāpayet .. 11 ..
16.343.d:
कृतस्नानजपः पश्चात्सूर्यायार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ..
रक्तचंदनतोयेन करवीरयुतेन च ..
कृत्वार्घपात्रं शिरसि मंत्रेणानेन दापयेत् .. 11 ..
16.343.m: having completed one's bath and recitation, one should then offer water oblations to the Sun / with red sandalwood water and oleander flowers; / placing the vessel of oblation on the head, one should offer it with this mantra:

16.343.s:
namastrailokyanāthāya udbhāsitajagattraya ..
vedaraśme namastubhyaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te .. 12 ..
16.343.d:
नमस्त्रैलोक्यनाथाय उद्भासितजगत्त्रय ..
वेदरश्मे नमस्तुभ्यं गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते .. 12 ..
16.343.m: “Obeisance to the lord of the three worlds, O illuminator of the three worlds, / O one whose rays are the Vedas, obeisance to you! Accept the water oblation, obeisance be to you!”

16.343.s:
sūryaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saṃpūjya kapileśvaram..
upalipte śubhe deśe puṣpākṣatavibhūṣite .. 13 ..
16.343.d:
सूर्यं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य संपूज्य कपिलेश्वरम्..
उपलिप्ते शुभे देशे पुष्पाक्षतविभूषिते .. 13 ..
16.343.m: Having circumambulated the Sun, and having worshipped Kapileśvara, / in an auspicious place smeared [with cow dung] and adorned with flowers and unhusked barley grains,

16.343.s:
sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ candanodakapūritam ..
paṃcaratnasamāyuktaṃ dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitam..14..
16.343.d:
स्थापयेदव्रणं कुम्भं चन्दनोदकपूरितम् ..
पंचरत्नसमायुक्तं दूर्वापुष्पाक्षतान्वितम्..14..
16.343.m: one should set up an unblemished pot filled with sandalwood water, / equipped with the five gems, and provided with dūrvā grass, flowers, and unhusked barley grains,

16.343.s:
raktavastrayugacchannaṃ tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
ratho rukmaphalasyaiva ekacitravicitritaḥ .. 15 ..
16.343.d:
रक्तवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं ताम्रपात्रेण संयुतम् ..
रथो रुक्मफलस्यैव एकचित्रविचित्रितः .. 15 ..
16.343.m: covered with a pair of red clothes, accompanied by a copper vessel, / [on] a chariot of gold leaf variegated with a single painting.

16.343.s:
sauvarṇapalasaṃyuktāṃ mūrtiṃ sūryasya kārayet..
kuṃbhasyopari saṃsthāpya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet .. 16 ..
16.343.d:
सौवर्णपलसंयुक्तां मूर्तिं सूर्यस्य कारयेत्..
कुंभस्योपरि संस्थाप्य गंधपुष्पैः समर्चयेत् .. 16 ..
16.343.m: One should fashion an image of the Sun containing a pala of gold; / placing it upon the pot, one should worship it with fragrant pastes and flowers.

16.343.s:
kapileśvarasānnidhye maṇḍape homasaṃskṛte ..
ādityaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ nāmabhiḥ svairyathoditaiḥ .. .. 17 ..
16.343.d:
कपिलेश्वरसान्निध्ये मण्डपे होमसंस्कृते ..
आदित्यं पूजयेद्देवं नामभिः स्वैर्यथोदितैः .. .. 17 ..
16.343.m: In the presence of Kapileśvara, in a pavilion consecrated with a fire offering, / one should worship the god Āditya by his names as declared:

16.343.s:
ādityabhāskara rave bhāno svayaṃ divākara ..
prabhākara namastubhyaṃ sasārānmāṃ samuddhara .. 18 ..
16.343.d:
आदित्यभास्कर रवे भानो स्वयं दिवाकर ..
प्रभाकर नमस्तुभ्यं ससारान्मां समुद्धर .. 18 ..
16.343.m: “O Āditya, Bhāskara, Ravi, Bhānu, self-manifest Divākara, / Prabhākara, obeisance to you! Deliver me from the cycle of worldly existence!

16.343.s: bhuktimuktiprado yasmāttasmācchāṃtiṃ prayaccha naḥ ..19..
16.343.d: भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदो यस्मात्तस्माच्छांतिं प्रयच्छ नः ..19..
16.343.m: Since you grant enjoyment and liberation, therefore bestow peace upon us!”

16.343.s:
.. prārthanāmantraḥ .. ..
namonamaste varada ṛksāmayajuṣāṃpate ..
namo'stuviśvarūpāya viśvadhāmne namo'stu te ..7.1.343.20..
16.343.d:
.. प्रार्थनामन्त्रः .. ..
नमोनमस्ते वरद ऋक्सामयजुषांपते ..
नमोऽस्तुविश्वरूपाय विश्वधाम्ने नमोऽस्तु ते ..7.1.343.20..
16.343.m:
The prayer mantra:
“Obeisance, obeisance to you, bestower of boons, lord of the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajur Vedas! / Obeisance be to the universal-formed one, obeisance be to the universal abode!”

16.343.s:
amṛtaṃ devi te kṣīraṃ pavitramiha puṣṭidam..
tvatprasādātpramucyaṃte manujāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ .. 21 ..
16.343.d:
अमृतं देवि ते क्षीरं पवित्रमिह पुष्टिदम्..
त्वत्प्रसादात्प्रमुच्यंते मनुजाः सर्वपातकैः .. 21 ..
16.343.m: “O goddess, your milk is nectar, pure and bestowing nourishment in this world; / by your grace, mortals are freed from all sins.

16.343.s:
brahmaṇotpādite devi vahnikuṇḍānmahāprabhe ..
namaste kapile puṇye sarvadevanamaskṛte ..22..
16.343.d:
ब्रह्मणोत्पादिते देवि वह्निकुण्डान्महाप्रभे ..
नमस्ते कपिले पुण्ये सर्वदेवनमस्कृते ..22..
