16.343.m: O goddess produced by Brahmā from the fire pit, O highly radiant one, / obeisance to you, O meritorious Kapilā, reverenced by all the gods!

16.343.s:
sarvadevamaye devi sarvatīrthamaye śubhe..
dātāraṃ pūjayānaṃ māṃ brahmalokaṃ naya svayam..23 ..
16.343.d:
सर्वदेवमये देवि सर्वतीर्थमये शुभे..
दातारं पूजयानं मां ब्रह्मलोकं नय स्वयम्..23 ..
16.343.m: O goddess consisting of all the gods, auspicious one consisting of all sacred fords, / lead me, the worshipping donor, personally to the world of Brahmā!”

16.343.s:
.. pūjāmaṃtraḥ .. ..
evaṃ saṃpūjya kapilāṃ kumbhasthaṃ ca divākaram..
brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣa ubhayaṃ pratipādayet ..24..
16.343.d:
.. पूजामंत्रः .. ..
एवं संपूज्य कपिलां कुम्भस्थं च दिवाकरम्..
ब्राह्मणे वेदविदुष उभयं प्रतिपादयेत् ..24..
16.343.m:
The worship mantra:
Having thus worshipped the brown cow and the Sun situated on the pot, / one should give both to a brahmin learned in the Vedas.

16.343.s: vyāsāya sūryabhaktāya maṃtreṇānena dāpayet ..25..
16.343.d: व्यासाय सूर्यभक्ताय मंत्रेणानेन दापयेत् ..25..
16.343.m: To an expounder devoted to the Sun, one should give with this mantra:

16.343.s:
divyamūrttirjagaccakṣu rdvādaśātmā divākaraḥ ..
kapilāsahito devo mama muktiṃ prayacchatu .. 26 ..
16.343.d:
दिव्यमूर्त्तिर्जगच्चक्षु र्द्वादशात्मा दिवाकरः ..
कपिलासहितो देवो मम मुक्तिं प्रयच्छतु .. 26 ..
16.343.m: “May the divine-formed Sun, the eye of the universe, the twelve-fold soul, / the god together with Kapilā, grant me liberation!

16.343.s:
yasmāttvaṃ kapile puṇyā sarvalokasya pāvanī ..
pradattā saha sūryeṇa mama muktipradā bhava .. 27 ..
16.343.d:
यस्मात्त्वं कपिले पुण्या सर्वलोकस्य पावनी ..
प्रदत्ता सह सूर्येण मम मुक्तिप्रदा भव .. 27 ..
16.343.m: Since you, O Kapilā, are meritorious, the purifier of all the world, / given together with the Sun, become a granter of liberation to me!”

16.343.s:
palena dakṣiṇā kāryā tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ ..
śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ tāṃ dhenuṃ pratipādayet .. 28 ..
16.343.d:
पलेन दक्षिणा कार्या तदर्धार्धेन वा पुनः ..
शक्तितो दक्षिणायुक्तां तां धेनुं प्रतिपादयेत् .. 28 ..
16.343.m: A priestly gift should be made with a pala [of gold], or with a quarter thereof; / according to one's capacity, one should bestow that cow accompanied by the priestly gift.

16.343.s:
yo'nena vidhinā kuryā tṣaṣṭhīṃ kapilasaṃjñitām..
so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 29 ..
16.343.d:
योऽनेन विधिना कुर्या त्षष्ठीं कपिलसंज्ञिताम्..
सोऽश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 29 ..
16.343.m: A person who performs the sixth day named Kapilā according to this rite, / that mortal obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

16.343.s:
yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ sarvamāpnoti yaḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kapilāṃ caret .. 7.1.343.30 ..
16.343.d:
यत्फलं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वदानेषु यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं सर्वमाप्नोति यः षष्ठीं कपिलां चरेत् .. 7.1.343.30 ..
16.343.m: Whatever fruit is obtained at all sacred fords, whatever fruit in all gifts, / all that fruit he obtains who observes the Kapilā sixth day.

16.343.s:
kapilākoṭisahasrāṇi kapilākoṭiśatāni ca ..
sūryaparvaṇi yaddattvā tatphalaṃ koṭiśo bhavet .. 31 ..
16.343.d:
कपिलाकोटिसहस्राणि कपिलाकोटिशतानि च ..
सूर्यपर्वणि यद्दत्त्वा तत्फलं कोटिशो भवेत् .. 31 ..
16.343.m: The fruit which is ten million-fold by giving ten million thousand, / or a hundred ten million brown cows on an eclipse day of the Sun [is obtained].

16.343.s:
koṭigoroma saṃkhyāni varṣāṇi varavarṇini ..
tāvatsa vasate svarge yaḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kapilāṃ caret .. 32 ..
16.343.d:
कोटिगोरोम संख्यानि वर्षाणि वरवर्णिनि ..
तावत्स वसते स्वर्गे यः षष्ठीं कपिलां चरेत् .. 32 ..
16.343.m: As many years as there are hairs on ten million cows, O fair-complexioned one, / for that long he resides in heaven who observes the Kapilā sixth day.

16.343.s:
jñānato'jñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti ityāha kapilo muniḥ ..33..
16.343.d:
ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो वापि यत्पापं पूर्वसंचितम् ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति इत्याह कपिलो मुनिः ..33..
16.343.m: Whatever sin was accumulated in the past, knowingly or unknowingly, / all that goes to destruction—thus said the sage Kapila.

16.343.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapi ladhārākapileśvaramāhātmye kapilāṣaṣṭhīvratavidhānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 343 ..
16.343.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कपि लधाराकपिलेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कपिलाषष्ठीव्रतविधानमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिचत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 343 ..
16.343.m: Thus ends the three hundred and forty-third chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of the Observance of Kapilāṣaṣṭhī in the Greatness of Kapiladhārā and Kapileśvara”, in the Greatness of the Prabhāsa Field, in the first [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

16.344.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
kapileśvarasyaiśānyāmuttareṇa vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.344.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
कपिलेश्वरस्यैशान्यामुत्तरेण व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.344.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga that destroys sins, / situated to the northeast and to the north of Kapileśvara,

16.344.s:
jaradgaveśvaraṃnāma jaradgavapratiṣṭhitam ..
brahmahatyādi pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2 ..
16.344.d:
जरद्गवेश्वरंनाम जरद्गवप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
ब्रह्महत्यादि पापानां नाशनं नात्र संशयः .. 2 ..
16.344.m: named Jaradgaveśvara, installed by Jaradgava, / the destroyer of sins such as the killing of a brahmin; there is no doubt in this.

16.344.s:
tatraiva saṃsthitā devi devī aṃśumatī nadī ..
tatra snātvā vidhānena piḍadānaṃ tu dāpayet .. 3 ..
16.344.d:
तत्रैव संस्थिता देवि देवी अंशुमती नदी ..
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन पिडदानं तु दापयेत् .. 3 ..
16.344.m: Right there is situated, O goddess, the divine river Aṃśumatī; / having bathed there according to the rule, one should offer the piṇḍa.

16.344.s:
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet ..
vṛṣabhastatra dātavyo brāhmaṇe vedapārage .. 4 ..
16.344.d:
वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं पितॄणां तृप्तिमावहेत् ..
वृषभस्तत्र दातव्यो ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे .. 4 ..
16.344.m: It brings satisfaction to the ancestors for more than a hundred million years; / a bull should be given there to a brahmin who has crossed to the end of the Vedas.

16.344.s:
tatastu pūjayeddevaṃ gandhapuṣpairjaradgavam ..
pañcāmṛtarasenaiva tathā guggu ludhūpanaiḥ .. 5 ..
16.344.d:
ततस्तु पूजयेद्देवं गन्धपुष्पैर्जरद्गवम् ..
पञ्चामृतरसेनैव तथा गुग्गु लुधूपनैः .. 5 ..
16.344.m: Then one should worship the god Jaradgava with fragrant pastes and flowers, / with the liquid of the five nectars, and with offerings of bdellium incense,

16.344.s:
stutidaṇḍanamaskāraiḥ pradakṣiṇairaharniśam ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
ekena bhojitenaiva koṭirbhavati bhojitā .. 6 ..
16.344.d:
स्तुतिदण्डनमस्कारैः प्रदक्षिणैरहर्निशम् ..
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्तत्र भक्ष्यभोज्यैः पृथग्विधैः ..
एकेन भोजितेनैव कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .. 6 ..
16.344.m: with praises, prostrations, and circumambulations, day and night; / one should feed brahmins there with different kinds of eatables and foods: / by feeding one alone, ten million are fed.

16.344.s:
kṛte siddhodakaṃnāma tattīrthaṃ parikīrttitam ..
jaradgaveśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ kalau tu parikīrtyate .. 7 ..
16.344.d:
कृते सिद्धोदकंनाम तत्तीर्थं परिकीर्त्तितम् ..
जरद्गवेश्वरं तीर्थं कलौ तु परिकीर्त्यते .. 7 ..
16.344.m: In the Kṛta age that sacred ford was known by the name Siddhodaka; / in the Kali age, however, it is celebrated as the Jaradgaveśvara sacred ford.

16.344.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'śumatīmāhātmye jaradgaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 344 ..
16.344.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येंऽशुमतीमाहात्म्ये जरद्गवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 344 ..
16.344.m: Thus ends the three hundred and forty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of Jaradgaveśvara in the Greatness of Aṃśumatī”, in the Greatness of the Prabhāsa Field, in the first [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

16.345.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vai hāṭakeśvaram ..
jaradgavātpūrvabhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhistribhiḥ .. 1 ..
16.345.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं वै हाटकेश्वरम् ..
जरद्गवात्पूर्वभागे धनुषां षष्टिभिस्त्रिभिः .. 1 ..
16.345.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga indeed of Hāṭakeśvara, / to the eastern part of Jaradgava, at a distance of sixty-three bow-lengths.

16.345.s:
nāmnā naleśvaraṃ devi sthāpitaṃ tu nalena vai ..
damayantīyutenaiva jñātvā kṣetraṃ taduttamam .. 2 ..
16.345.d:
नाम्ना नलेश्वरं देवि स्थापितं तु नलेन वै ..
दमयन्तीयुतेनैव ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रं तदुत्तमम् .. 2 ..
16.345.m: Named Naleśvara, O goddess, installed indeed by Nala / accompanied by Damayantī, knowing that best of sacred fields.

16.345.s: taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ .. kalibhirmucyate jaṃturdyūte ca vijayī bhavet .. 3 ..
16.345.d: तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि पूजयित्वा विधानतः .. कलिभिर्मुच्यते जंतुर्द्यूते च विजयी भवेत् .. 3 ..
16.345.m: Having seen it, O goddess, and having worshipped according to the ordinances, a mortal / is freed from strife, and a creature becomes victorious in gambling.

16.345.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye naleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 345 ..
16.345.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 345 ..
16.345.m: Thus ends the three hundred and forty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Naleśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Saṃhitā of eighty-one thousand [verses] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

16.346.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādāgneyadigbhāge sthitaḥ karkoṭako raviḥ ..
pūrvakalpe mahādevi smṛtaḥ karkoṭakānvitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.346.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादाग्नेयदिग्भागे स्थितः कर्कोटको रविः ..
पूर्वकल्पे महादेवि स्मृतः कर्कोटकान्वितः .. 1 ..
16.346.m: Īśvara said: / Situated to the southeast of that is the sun [known as] Karkoṭaka; / in a previous kalpa, O great goddess, it is remembered as associated with Karkoṭaka.

16.346.s:
tasya darśanamātreṇa prītāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa dhūpa gaṃdhānulepanaiḥ ..
pūjayedyo vidhānena mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.346.d:
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण प्रीताः स्युः सर्वदेवताः ..
सप्तम्यां रविवारेण धूप गंधानुलेपनैः ..
पूजयेद्यो विधानेन मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 2 ..
16.346.m: Merely by seeing it, all the deities are pleased. / Whoever worships [it] according to the ordinances with incense, fragrant pastes, and ointments / on the seventh lunar day falling on a Sunday, is freed from all sins.

16.346.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye karkoṭakārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 346 ..
16.346.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कर्कोटकार्कमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षटचत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 346 ..
16.346.m: Thus ends the three hundred and forty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Karkoṭakārka', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Saṃhitā of eighty-one thousand [verses] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

16.347.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vai hāṭakeśvaram ..
naleśvarātpūrvabhāge śatadhanvaṃtaradvaye .. 1 ..
16.347.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं वै हाटकेश्वरम् ..
नलेश्वरात्पूर्वभागे शतधन्वंतरद्वये .. 1 ..
16.347.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the Hāṭakeśvara liṅga, / situated to the east of Naleśvara at a distance of two hundred bow-lengths.

16.347.s:
agastyāmravanaṃnāma tatra sthāne tu saṃsthitam ..
ciṃtāmaṇestu pūrveṇa īśāne triśataṃdhanuḥ ..
tatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptamagastyena mahātmanā .. 2 ..
16.347.d:
अगस्त्याम्रवनंनाम तत्र स्थाने तु संस्थितम् ..
चिंतामणेस्तु पूर्वेण ईशाने त्रिशतंधनुः ..
तत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तमगस्त्येन महात्मना .. 2 ..
16.347.m: The mango grove named Agastyāmravana is located in that place; / three hundred bow-lengths to the east of Cintāmaṇi, in the northeast. / There, austerity was performed in ancient times by the great-souled Agastya.

16.347.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kasminkāle mahādeva sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 3 .. ..
16.347.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कस्मिन्काले महादेव सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 3 .. ..
16.347.m: The goddess said: / At what time, O Mahādeva? Tell me everything in detail!

16.347.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
purā daityagaṇā raudrā babhūvurvaravarṇini ..
kālakeyā iti khyātāstrailokyocchedakārakāḥ .. 4 ..
16.347.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पुरा दैत्यगणा रौद्रा बभूवुर्वरवर्णिनि ..
कालकेया इति ख्यातास्त्रैलोक्योच्छेदकारकाः .. 4 ..
16.347.m: Īśvara said: / Long ago, O fair-complexioned one, there were fearsome hordes of Daityas / known as the Kālakeyas, who caused the destruction of the three worlds.

16.347.s:
atha te nihatāḥ sarve viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
daityasūdananāmnā tu prabhāsakṣetravāsinā .. 5 ..
16.347.d:
अथ ते निहताः सर्वे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
दैत्यसूदननाम्ना तु प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिना .. 5 ..
16.347.m: Then they were all slain by the all-powerful Viṣṇu, / residing in Prabhāsa-kṣetra under the name Daityasūdana,

16.347.s:
kṛtvā vyāghrasya rūpaṃ tu nāmnā cakramukhīti ca ..
hatā vai tena rūpeṇa tato'bhūddaityasūdanaḥ .. 6 ..
16.347.d:
कृत्वा व्याघ्रस्य रूपं तु नाम्ना चक्रमुखीति च ..
हता वै तेन रूपेण ततोऽभूद्दैत्यसूदनः .. 6 ..
16.347.m: having assumed the form of a tiger named Cakramukhī. / By means of that form, they were indeed slain; thereafter He became [known as] Daityasūdana.

16.347.s:
hataśeṣāḥ samudrāṃte praviṣṭā bhayavihvalāḥ ..
tataste maṃtrayāmāsuḥ pīḍyaṃte devatāḥ katham ..7..
hanyaṃtāṃ dharmiṇo ye'tra vidyaṃte dhara ṇītale ..
tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratā yajñadānaratāśca ye .. 5 ..
16.347.d:
हतशेषाः समुद्रांते प्रविष्टा भयविह्वलाः ..
ततस्ते मंत्रयामासुः पीड्यंते देवताः कथम् ..7..
हन्यंतां धर्मिणो येऽत्र विद्यंते धर णीतले ..
तपःस्वाध्यायनिरता यज्ञदानरताश्च ये .. 5 ..
16.347.m:
Those who survived the slaughter entered the interior of the ocean, distraught with fear; / then they deliberated: 'How can the deities be tormented?'
'Let the righteous ones who exist here on the face of the earth be slain— / those devoted to austerity and Vedic recitation, and those devoted to sacrifice and charity.'

16.347.s:
atha te samayaṃ kṛtvā rātrau niṣkramya sāgarāt ..
nirjaghnustāpasāṃstatra yajñadānaratānpriye .. 9 ..
16.347.d:
अथ ते समयं कृत्वा रात्रौ निष्क्रम्य सागरात् ..
निर्जघ्नुस्तापसांस्तत्र यज्ञदानरतान्प्रिये .. 9 ..
16.347.m: Then, having made an agreement, emerging from the ocean at night, / they slaughtered the ascetics there who were devoted to sacrifice and charity, O beloved.

16.347.s:
prabhāse tu mahādevi tatra dvādaśayojane ..
vasiṣṭhasyāśrame tatra maharṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām .. 7.1.346(2).10 ..
bhakṣitāni sahasrāṇi paṃca sapta ca tāpasān ..
śatāni paṃca raibhyasya viśvāmitrasya ṣoḍaśa .. 11 ..
16.347.d:
प्रभासे तु महादेवि तत्र द्वादशयोजने ..
वसिष्ठस्याश्रमे तत्र महर्षीणां महात्मनाम् .. 7.1.346(2).10 ..
भक्षितानि सहस्राणि पंच सप्त च तापसान् ..
शतानि पंच रैभ्यस्य विश्वामित्रस्य षोडश .. 11 ..
16.347.m: In Prabhāsa, O great goddess, in that area of twelve yojanas, / in the hermitage of Vasiṣṭha, five thousand ascetics / [and] seven [thousand] of the great-souled great seers were devoured; / five hundred of Raibhya's, sixteen [hundred] of Viśvāmitra's,

16.347.s:
cyavanasya ca saptaiva jābālerdviśataṃ muneḥ ..
vālakhilyāśrame puṇye ṣaṭchatāni durātmabhiḥ .. 12 ..
16.347.d:
च्यवनस्य च सप्तैव जाबालेर्द्विशतं मुनेः ..
वालखिल्याश्रमे पुण्ये षट्छतानि दुरात्मभिः .. 12 ..
16.347.m: seven of Cyavana's, two hundred of the sage Jābāli's, / [and] six hundred in the sacred hermitage of the Vālakhilyas [were devoured] by those evil-minded ones.

16.347.s:
yatra kvacidbhavedyajñastatra gatvā niśāgame ..
yajñadānasamāyuktānṛtvijo bhakṣayaṃti ca .. 13 ..
16.347.d:
यत्र क्वचिद्भवेद्यज्ञस्तत्र गत्वा निशागमे ..
यज्ञदानसमायुक्तानृत्विजो भक्षयंति च .. 13 ..
16.347.m: Wherever a sacrifice took place, having gone there at nightfall, / they devoured the officiating priests engaged in sacrifice and charity.

16.347.s:
tato bhayākulāḥ sarve babhūvurjagatī tale ..
na ca kaścidvijānāti daityānāṃ tu viceṣṭitam .. 14 ..
16.347.d:
ततो भयाकुलाः सर्वे बभूवुर्जगती तले ..
न च कश्चिद्विजानाति दैत्यानां तु विचेष्टितम् .. 14 ..
16.347.m: Then all became agitated with fear on the face of the earth; / and no one knew the activity of the Daityas.

16.347.s:
rātrau svapaṃti munayaḥ sukhaśayyāgatāśca te ..
prabhāte tvadhvare teṣāmasthisaṃghāśca kevalam ..15..
16.347.d:
रात्रौ स्वपंति मुनयः सुखशय्यागताश्च ते ..
प्रभाते त्वध्वरे तेषामस्थिसंघाश्च केवलम् ..15..
16.347.m: At night the sages slept, having gone to comfortable beds; / but in the morning, at their sacrificial rites, only heaps of bones [remained].

16.347.s:
tato dharmakriyāstyaktā bhūtale sarvamānavaiḥ ..
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ bhūtalaṃ samapadyata .. 16 ..
16.347.d:
ततो धर्मक्रियास्त्यक्ता भूतले सर्वमानवैः ..
निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारं भूतलं समपद्यत .. 16 ..
16.347.m: Then religious rites were abandoned by all mortals on the face of the earth; / the earth became devoid of Vedic recitation and the vaṣaṭ-call.

16.347.s:
athānye tāpasā rātrau saṃyutāśca ca dhṛtāyudhāḥ ..
athocchedaṃ gate dharme pīḍitāstridivaukasaḥ .. 17 ..
16.347.d:
अथान्ये तापसा रात्रौ संयुताश्च च धृतायुधाः ..
अथोच्छेदं गते धर्मे पीडितास्त्रिदिवौकसः .. 17 ..
16.347.m: Then other ascetics joined together at night, bearing weapons; / and as dharma was being eradicated, the denizens of heaven were distressed.

16.347.s:
kimetaditi jalpaṃto brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
bhagavaṃstāpasāḥ sarve tathā ye jñānaśīlinaḥ .. 18 ..
16.347.d:
किमेतदिति जल्पंतो ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः ..
भगवंस्तापसाः सर्वे तथा ये ज्ञानशीलिनः .. 18 ..
16.347.m: Saying 'What is this?', they went to Brahmā for refuge: / 'O blessed one, all the ascetics as well as those possessed of knowledge

16.347.s:
bhakṣyante kenacidrātrau mṛtyumeva prayānti ca ..
naṣṭadharmakriyāḥ sarve bhūtale prapitāmaha .. 19 ..
16.347.d:
भक्ष्यन्ते केनचिद्रात्रौ मृत्युमेव प्रयान्ति च ..
नष्टधर्मक्रियाः सर्वे भूतले प्रपितामह .. 19 ..
16.347.m: are being devoured by someone at night and are going to their deaths. / On the face of the earth, all religious rites have perished, O Great-grandfather!

16.347.s:
yo dharmamācaredahni sa rātrau mṛtyumeti ca ..
na svādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ samaste bhūtale vibho .. 7.1.346(2).20 ..
dharmābhāvādvayaṃ sarve saṃdehaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā devaḥ pitāmahaḥ ..
abravīttridaśānsarvānsandehaṃ paramaṃ gatān .. 21 ..
16.347.d:
यो धर्ममाचरेदह्नि स रात्रौ मृत्युमेति च ..
न स्वाध्यायवषट्कारं समस्ते भूतले विभो .. 7.1.346(2).20 ..
धर्माभावाद्वयं सर्वे संदेहं परमं गताः ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ध्यात्वा देवः पितामहः ..
अब्रवीत्त्रिदशान्सर्वान्सन्देहं परमं गतान् .. 21 ..
16.347.m: He who performs righteous deeds by day meets death at night; / there is no Vedic recitation or vaṣaṭ-call across the whole surface of the earth, O Lord! / Due to the absence of dharma, we have all fallen into great doubt.' / Hearing that speech of theirs, having meditated, the divine Grandfather / spoke to all the thirty [gods] who had fallen into great perplexity:

16.347.s:
kāleyā iti vikhyātā dānavā raudrakāriṇaḥ ..
te samudraṃ samāsādya tāpasānbhakṣayaṃti ca .. 22 ..
16.347.d:
कालेया इति विख्याता दानवा रौद्रकारिणः ..
ते समुद्रं समासाद्य तापसान्भक्षयंति च .. 22 ..
16.347.m: 'The Dānavas renowned as the Kāleyas act terrifyingly; / having taken to the ocean, they devour the ascetics.

16.347.s:
yuṣmākaṃ ca vināśāya te na śakyā niṣūditum ..
yatadhvameṣāṃ nāśāya no cennāśo bhaviṣyati .. 23 ..
16.347.d:
युष्माकं च विनाशाय ते न शक्या निषूदितुम् ..
यतध्वमेषां नाशाय नो चेन्नाशो भविष्यति .. 23 ..
16.347.m: They cannot be slain by you, for your own destruction [would follow]; / strive for their destruction, otherwise your destruction will occur.

16.347.s:
vrajadhvaṃ bhūtale śīghramagastyo yatra tiṣṭhati..
vratacaryārato nityaṃ prabhāse kṣetra uttame .. 24 ..
16.347.d:
व्रजध्वं भूतले शीघ्रमगस्त्यो यत्र तिष्ठति..
व्रतचर्यारतो नित्यं प्रभासे क्षेत्र उत्तमे .. 24 ..
16.347.m: Go quickly to the earth where Agastya resides, / constantly devoted to vows and religious observances in the best sacred field, Prabhāsa.

16.347.s:
sa śaktaḥ sāgaraṃ pātuṃ mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ ..
prasādyaśca sa yuṣmābhiḥ samudraṃ piba sattama .. 25 ..
16.347.d:
स शक्तः सागरं पातुं मित्रावरुणसंभवः ..
प्रसाद्यश्च स युष्माभिः समुद्रं पिब सत्तम .. 25 ..
16.347.m: He, born of Mitra and Varuṇa, is capable of drinking the ocean; / and he must be propitiated by you: "Drink the ocean, O best of men!"

16.347.s:
tatastathā kṛte tena te sarve dānavādhamāḥ ..
vadhyā yuṣmākaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti evaṃ ca tridiveśvarāḥ .. 26 ..
16.347.d:
ततस्तथा कृते तेन ते सर्वे दानवाधमाः ..
वध्या युष्माकं भविष्यंति एवं च त्रिदिवेश्वराः .. 26 ..
16.347.m: Then, once that is done by him, all those lowest of Dānavas / will be fit to be killed by you; and thus, O lords of heaven!'

16.347.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya agastyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 27 ..
16.347.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य अगस्त्यं शरणं गताः .. 27 ..
16.347.m: Īśvara said: / Having been addressed thus by Brahmā, the creator of the worlds, all the gods, / having arrived at Prabhāsa-kṣetra, went to Agastya for refuge.

16.347.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
rakṣarakṣa dvijaśreṣṭha trailokyaṃ saṃśayaṃ gatam ..
kālakeyaiḥ pratidhvastaṃ samudraṃ samupāśritaiḥ .. 28 ..
16.347.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
रक्षरक्ष द्विजश्रेष्ठ त्रैलोक्यं संशयं गतम् ..
कालकेयैः प्रतिध्वस्तं समुद्रं समुपाश्रितैः .. 28 ..
16.347.m: The gods said: / 'Protect, protect, O best among the twice-born! The three worlds have fallen into jeopardy, / ravaged by the Kālakeyas who have taken refuge in the ocean.

16.347.s:
taṃ śoṣaya dvijaśreṣṭha hitārthaṃ tridivaukasām ..
nānyaḥ śaktaḥ pumānkaścitkartumīdṛkkriyā vibho .. 29 ..
16.347.d:
तं शोषय द्विजश्रेष्ठ हितार्थं त्रिदिवौकसाम् ..
नान्यः शक्तः पुमान्कश्चित्कर्तुमीदृक्क्रिया विभो .. 29 ..
16.347.m: Dry it up, O best among the twice-born, for the welfare of the denizens of heaven; / no other person is capable of performing such an act, O Lord!'

16.347.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamuktaḥ suragaṇairagastyo munipuṅgavaḥ ..
jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ samudraṃ prati harṣitaḥ .. 7.1.346(2).30 ..
gīyamānastu gaṃdharvaiḥ stūyamānastu kinnaraiḥ ..
ślāghyamānastu vibudhairvākyametaduvāca ha .. 31 ..
16.347.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तः सुरगणैरगस्त्यो मुनिपुङ्गवः ..
जगाम त्रिदशैः सार्धं समुद्रं प्रति हर्षितः .. 7.1.346(2).30 ..
गीयमानस्तु गंधर्वैः स्तूयमानस्तु किन्नरैः ..
श्लाघ्यमानस्तु विबुधैर्वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 31 ..
16.347.m: Īśvara said: / Thus addressed by the hosts of gods, Agastya, the eminent sage, / went towards the ocean with the thirty [gods], filled with joy. / Being sung by the Gandharvas, praised by the Kinnaras, / and extolled by the gods, he spoke these words:

16.347.s:
eṣa trailokyarakṣārthaṃ śoṣayāmi mahārṇavam ..
drakṣyadhvaṃ kautukaṃ devāḥ samīnamakarairmahat .. 32 ..
16.347.d:
एष त्रैलोक्यरक्षार्थं शोषयामि महार्णवम् ..
द्रक्ष्यध्वं कौतुकं देवाः समीनमकरैर्महत् .. 32 ..
16.347.m: 'Here, for the protection of the three worlds, I shall dry up the great ocean; / you gods shall witness a great wonder, along with fish and makaras!'

16.347.s:
evamuktvā dvijaśreṣṭho hyagastyo bhagavānmuniḥ ..
gaṃḍūṣamakarotsarvaṃ sāgaraṃ saritāṃpatim .. 33 ..
16.347.d:
एवमुक्त्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठो ह्यगस्त्यो भगवान्मुनिः ..
गंडूषमकरोत्सर्वं सागरं सरितांपतिम् .. 33 ..
16.347.m: Having spoken thus, the best among the twice-born, the revered sage Agastya, / made a single sip of the entire ocean, the lord of rivers.

16.347.s:
pīte tatra mahāsindhāvagatsye na mahātmanā ..
dānavā bhayasaṃtrastā itaścetaśca babhramuḥ .. 34 ..
16.347.d:
पीते तत्र महासिन्धावगत्स्ये न महात्मना ..
दानवा भयसंत्रस्ता इतश्चेतश्च बभ्रमुः .. 34 ..
16.347.m: When that great ocean was drunk there by the great-souled Agastya, / the Dānavas, terrified with fear, wandered to and fro.

16.347.s:
vadhyamānāḥ suraistatra śastraiḥ suniśitaistathā ..
kāṃtāramanye gacchaṃtaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇā .. 35 ..
16.347.d:
वध्यमानाः सुरैस्तत्र शस्त्रैः सुनिशितैस्तथा ..
कांतारमन्ये गच्छंतः पलायनपरायणा .. 35 ..
16.347.m: Being slain there by the gods with exceedingly sharp weapons, / others, intent on flight, fled into the wilderness. 35

16.347.s:
hatabhūyeṣu daityeṣu vidārya dharaṇītalam ..
pātālaṃ viviśustūrṇaṃ rudhireṇa pariplutāḥ .. 36 ..
16.347.d:
हतभूयेषु दैत्येषु विदार्य धरणीतलम् ..
पातालं विविशुस्तूर्णं रुधिरेण परिप्लुताः .. 36 ..
16.347.m: When most of the Daityas had been killed, tearing through the surface of the earth, / drenched in blood, they swiftly entered Pātāla. 36

16.347.s:
athocustridaśā hṛṣṭā agastyaṃ munisattamam ..
siddhaṃ no vāṃchitaṃ sarvaṃ pūryatāṃ sāgaraḥ punaḥ .. 37 ..
16.347.d:
अथोचुस्त्रिदशा हृष्टा अगस्त्यं मुनिसत्तमम् ..
सिद्धं नो वांछितं सर्वं पूर्यतां सागरः पुनः .. 37 ..
16.347.m: Then the delighted thirty [gods] said to Agastya, the best of sages: / 'All that we desired has been achieved; let the ocean be filled again.' 37

16.347.s:
.. agastya uvāca .. ..
jīrṇaṃ toyaṃ mayā devāstathaivāmedhyatāṃ gatam ..
utpatsyati raghūṇāṃ hi kule nṛpatisattamaḥ .. 38 ..
16.347.d:
.. अगस्त्य उवाच .. ..
जीर्णं तोयं मया देवास्तथैवामेध्यतां गतम् ..
उत्पत्स्यति रघूणां हि कुले नृपतिसत्तमः .. 38 ..
16.347.m: Agastya said: / 'The water has been digested by me, O gods, and has likewise become impure. / Indeed, an excellent king will be born in the lineage of the Raghus, 38

16.347.s:
bhagīratheti vikhyātaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ..
sa jñātikāraṇādeva gaṃgāṃ tatrānayiṣyati .. 39 ..
16.347.d:
भगीरथेति विख्यातः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ..
स ज्ञातिकारणादेव गंगां तत्रानयिष्यति .. 39 ..
16.347.m: renowned as Bhagīratha, foremost among all weapon-bearers. / For the sake of his kinsmen, he will bring Gaṅgā there. 39

16.347.s:
brahmalokātsaricchreṣṭhāṃ tayā pūrṇo bhaviṣyati..
evamuktvā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ svasthānaṃ cāgamanmuniḥ .. 7.1.346(2).40 ..
tataḥ svamāśramaṃ prāptaṃ devā vākyamathābuvan ..
anena karmaṇā brahmanparituṣṭā vayaṃ mune .. 41 ..
16.347.d:
ब्रह्मलोकात्सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां तया पूर्णो भविष्यति..
एवमुक्त्वा सुरैः सार्द्धं स्वस्थानं चागमन्मुनिः .. 7.1.346(2).40 ..
ततः स्वमाश्रमं प्राप्तं देवा वाक्यमथाबुवन् ..
अनेन कर्मणा ब्रह्मन्परितुष्टा वयं मुने .. 41 ..
16.347.m: The [ocean] will be filled by that best of rivers [coming] from the world of Brahmā.' / Having spoken thus, the sage went to his own place together with the gods. 40 / Then, when he had arrived at his own hermitage, the gods spoke these words: / 'O brahmin, O sage, we are well pleased by this deed of yours. 41

16.347.s: kiṃ kurmo brūhi te'bhīṣṭaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 42 ..
16.347.d: किं कुर्मो ब्रूहि तेऽभीष्टं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 42 ..
16.347.m: Tell [us] your desire; what shall we do, even if it is very difficult to obtain?' 42

16.347.s:
.. agastya uvāca .. ..
yāvadbrahmasahasrāṇi paṃcaviṃśatikoṭayaḥ ..
vaimāniko bhaviṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃbaramūrddhani .. 43 ..
16.347.d:
.. अगस्त्य उवाच .. ..
यावद्ब्रह्मसहस्राणि पंचविंशतिकोटयः ..
वैमानिको भविष्यामि दक्षिणांबरमूर्द्धनि .. 43 ..
16.347.m: Agastya said: / 'For as long as twenty-five crores of thousands of Brahmās, / I shall dwell in an aerial chariot at the crown of the southern sky. 43

16.347.s:
atrāgatya naro yastu mamāśramapade śubhe ..
hāṭakeśvarasāṃnidhye prabhāsakṣetra uttame .. 44 ..
16.347.d:
अत्रागत्य नरो यस्तु ममाश्रमपदे शुभे ..
हाटकेश्वरसांनिध्ये प्रभासक्षेत्र उत्तमे .. 44 ..
16.347.m: Whatever person, having come here to my auspicious hermitage-seat, / in the presence of Hāṭakeśvara in the supreme Prabhāsa sacred field, 44

16.347.s:
snānamācarate samyaksa yātu paramāṃ gatim ..
pātālādavatīrṇaṃ taṃ liṃgarūpaṃ maheśvaram .. 45 ..
16.347.d:
स्नानमाचरते सम्यक्स यातु परमां गतिम् ..
पातालादवतीर्णं तं लिंगरूपं महेश्वरम् .. 45 ..
16.347.m: properly performs a ritual ablution, may he attain the supreme state. / That Maheśvara in the form of a liṅga, who ascended from Pātāla 45

16.347.s:
mayā tapaḥ prabhāvena sthāpitaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet ..
dinedine bhavettasya gośatasya phalaṃ dhruvam .. 46 ..
16.347.d:
मया तपः प्रभावेन स्थापितं यः प्रपूजयेत् ..
दिनेदिने भवेत्तस्य गोशतस्य फलं ध्रुवम् .. 46 ..
16.347.m: and was established by me through the power of austerity—whoever worships him, / day by day the fruit of [donating] a hundred cows will surely be his. 46

16.347.s:
lopāmudrāsahāyaṃ māṃ yo martyaḥ saṃprapūjayet ..
arghyaṃ dadyādvidhānena kāśa puṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ .. 47 ..
16.347.d:
लोपामुद्रासहायं मां यो मर्त्यः संप्रपूजयेत् ..
अर्घ्यं दद्याद्विधानेन काश पुष्पैः समाहितः .. 47 ..
16.347.m: Whatever mortal worships me accompanied by Lopāmudrā, / and, composed in mind, duly offers an arghya with kāśa flowers 47

16.347.s:
prāpte śaradi kāle ca sa yātu paramāṃ gatim ..
lopāmudrāsahāyaṃ māṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃyutam .. 48 ..
16.347.d:
प्राप्ते शरदि काले च स यातु परमां गतिम् ..
लोपामुद्रासहायं मां हाटकेश्वरसंयुतम् .. 48 ..
16.347.m: when the autumn season arrives, may he attain the supreme state. / Having worshipped me accompanied by Lopāmudrā, united with Hāṭakeśvara, 48

16.347.s:
ayane cottare pūjya golakṣa phalamāpnuyāt ..
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute cātra ayane cottare dvijaḥ..
bhūyāttasya phalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ gayāśrāddhasya sattamāḥ .. 49 ..
16.347.d:
अयने चोत्तरे पूज्य गोलक्ष फलमाप्नुयात् ..
यः श्राद्धं कुरुते चात्र अयने चोत्तरे द्विजः..
भूयात्तस्य फलं कृत्स्नं गयाश्राद्धस्य सत्तमाः .. 49 ..
16.347.m: during the northern solstice, one obtains the fruit of [donating] a hundred thousand cows. / And whatever twice-born performs a śrāddha here during the northern solstice, / O best of men, his shall be the entire fruit of a śrāddha performed at Gayā.' 49

16.347.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
bāḍhamitye va te coktvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ..
svasthānaṃ tu gatāḥ sarve saṃhṛṣṭamanasastadā ..7.1.346(2).50..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena prāpte śaradi mānavaḥ..
agastyasyāśramaṃ gatvā hāṭakeśaṃ prapūjayet .. 51 ..
16.347.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
बाढमित्ये व ते चोक्त्वा सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः..
स्वस्थानं तु गताः सर्वे संहृष्टमनसस्तदा ..7.1.346(2).50..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन प्राप्ते शरदि मानवः..
अगस्त्यस्याश्रमं गत्वा हाटकेशं प्रपूजयेत् .. 51 ..
16.347.m: Īśvara said: / Having said 'So be it,' all the gods together with Vāsava / went to their respective abodes with delighted minds. 50 / Therefore, by every effort, when autumn arrives, a mortal / should go to the hermitage of Agastya and worship Hāṭakeśa, 51

16.347.s:
agastyeśvaranāmānaṃ kalpaliṃgaṃ surapriyam ..
yaścaitacchuṇuyādbhaktyā ṛṣestasya viceṣṭitam..
ahorātrakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇā deva mucyate .. 52 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye hāṭakeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 346(?) ..
16.347.d:
अगस्त्येश्वरनामानं कल्पलिंगं सुरप्रियम् ..
यश्चैतच्छुणुयाद्भक्त्या ऋषेस्तस्य विचेष्टितम्..
अहोरात्रकृतात्पापात्तत्क्षणा देव मुच्यते .. 52 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये हाटकेश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम षट्चत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 346(?) ..
16.347.m:
the liṅga of the cosmic age known as Agastyeśvara, dear to the gods. / And whoever hears with devotion this deed of that seer / is at that very moment freed from sin committed during a day and night. 52
Thus ends the three hundred forty-sixth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 346

16.348.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi paścime nāradeśvarīm ..
nāradeśvarasāṃnidhye sarvadaurbhāgyanāśanīm .. 1 ..
16.348.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पश्चिमे नारदेश्वरीम् ..
नारदेश्वरसांनिध्ये सर्वदौर्भाग्यनाशनीम् .. 1 ..
16.348.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Nāradeśvarī in the west, / in the presence of Nāradeśvara, the destroyer of all misfortune. 1

16.348.s:
yā nārī pūjayeddevīṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ samāhitā ..
tadanvaye na daurbhāgyayuktā nārī bhaviṣyati .. 2 ..
16.348.d:
या नारी पूजयेद्देवीं तृतीयायां समाहिता ..
तदन्वये न दौर्भाग्ययुक्ता नारी भविष्यति .. 2 ..
16.348.m: Whatever woman, composed in mind, worships the goddess on the third lunar day, / in her lineage there will never be a woman afflicted with misfortune. 2

16.348.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāradeśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 347 ..
16.348.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नारदेश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तचत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 347 ..
16.348.m: Thus ends the three hundred forty-seventh chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Nāradeśvarī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 347

16.349.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ maṃtravibhūṣaṇām ..
bhīmeśvarasya sānnidhye somenārādhitāṃ purā .. 1 ..
16.349.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवीं मंत्रविभूषणाम् ..
भीमेश्वरस्य सान्निध्ये सोमेनाराधितां पुरा .. 1 ..
16.349.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the goddess Mantravibhūṣaṇā, / in the presence of Bhīmeśvara, worshipped in ancient times by Soma. 1

16.349.s:
śrāvaṇe māsi vidhinā yā nārī tāṃ prapūjayet ..
tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklapakṣe sā duḥkhairmucyate'khilaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.349.d:
श्रावणे मासि विधिना या नारी तां प्रपूजयेत् ..
तृतीयायां शुक्लपक्षे सा दुःखैर्मुच्यतेऽखिलैः .. 2 ..
16.349.m: Whatever woman duly worships her in the month of Śrāvaṇa / on the third day of the bright fortnight, she is freed from all miseries. 2

16.349.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mantravibhūṣaṇāgaurī māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 348 ..
16.349.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मन्त्रविभूषणागौरी माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाचत्वारिंशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 348 ..
16.349.m: Thus ends the three hundred forty-eighth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Mantravibhūṣaṇā Gaurī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 348

16.350.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi viśveśaṃ durgakūṭakam ..
bhallatīrthasya pūrveṇa yoginīcakradakṣiṇe .. 1 ..
16.350.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विश्वेशं दुर्गकूटकम् ..
भल्लतीर्थस्य पूर्वेण योगिनीचक्रदक्षिणे .. 1 ..
16.350.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Viśveśa Durgakūṭaka, / east of Bhallatīrtha and south of the Yoginīcakra. 1

16.350.s:
ārādhito'sau bhīmena sarvakāmaprado'bhavat ..
phālgunasya caturthyāṃ tu śuklapakṣe vidhānataḥ .. .. 2 ..
16.350.d:
आराधितोऽसौ भीमेन सर्वकामप्रदोऽभवत् ..
फाल्गुनस्य चतुर्थ्यां तु शुक्लपक्षे विधानतः .. .. 2 ..
16.350.m: Worshipped by Bhīma, he became the bestower of all desires. / On the fourth day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, according to rule, 2

16.350.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate devaṃ gandhapuṣpaiḥ samodakaiḥ ..
nirvighnaṃ jāyate tasya varṣamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 3 ..
16.350.d:
यस्तं पूजयते देवं गन्धपुष्पैः समोदकैः ..
निर्विघ्नं जायते तस्य वर्षमेकं न संशयः .. 3 ..
16.350.m: whoever worships that god with fragrant substances, flowers, and water, / for one year his affairs become free from obstacles, without doubt. 3

16.350.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye durgakūṭagaṇapatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 349 ..
16.350.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दुर्गकूटगणपतिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनपञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 349 ..
16.350.m: Thus ends the three hundred forty-ninth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Durgakūṭa Gaṇapati', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 349

16.351.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasmādvai kauraveśvarīm ..
yasya nāmnā kurukṣetraṃ tena sārādhitā purā .. 1 ..
16.351.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्माद्वै कौरवेश्वरीम् ..
यस्य नाम्ना कुरुक्षेत्रं तेन साराधिता पुरा .. 1 ..
16.351.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, from there one should go indeed to Kauraveśvarī, / worshipped in ancient times by him after whose name Kurukṣetra [is called]. 1

16.351.s:
ārādhitā'sau bhīmena kṛtvā kṣetrasya rakṣaṇam ..
mahānavamyāṃ yatnena yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
taṃ putramiva kalyāṇī rakṣate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2 ..
16.351.d:
आराधिताऽसौ भीमेन कृत्वा क्षेत्रस्य रक्षणम् ..
महानवम्यां यत्नेन यस्तां पूजयते नरः ..
तं पुत्रमिव कल्याणी रक्षते नात्र संशयः .. 2 ..
16.351.m: She was worshipped by Bhīma after protecting the sacred field. / Whatever man worships her with effort on the Mahānavamī, / the auspicious goddess protects him like a son, there is no doubt here. 2

16.351.s:
bhojanaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ daṃpatīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
divyairbhakṣyaiḥ sumiṣṭānnaiḥ sā tuṣyati tataḥ stutā .. 3 ..
16.351.d:
भोजनं तत्र दातव्यं दंपतीनां न संशयः ..
दिव्यैर्भक्ष्यैः सुमिष्टान्नैः सा तुष्यति ततः स्तुता .. 3 ..
16.351.m: Food should certainly be given to married couples there; / with divine delicacies and very sweet food she is pleased when praised thereafter. 3

16.351.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kauraveśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 350 ..
16.351.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कौरवेश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 350 ..
16.351.m: Thus ends the three hundred fiftieth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Kauraveśvarī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 350

16.352.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi suparṇelāṃ ca bhairavīm ..
durgakūṭāddakṣiṇato dhanuḥpaṃcaśatāṃtare .. 1 ..
16.352.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सुपर्णेलां च भैरवीम् ..
दुर्गकूटाद्दक्षिणतो धनुःपंचशतांतरे .. 1 ..
16.352.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Suparṇelā Bhairavī, / five hundred bow-lengths south of Durgakūṭa. 1

16.352.s:
suparṇena purā devi pātālādamṛtaṃ hṛtam ..
gṛhītvā tatra muktaṃ tu nāgānāṃ paśyatāṃ kila .. 2 ..
16.352.d:
सुपर्णेन पुरा देवि पातालादमृतं हृतम् ..
गृहीत्वा तत्र मुक्तं तु नागानां पश्यतां किल .. 2 ..
16.352.m: Anciently, O goddess, the nectar was carried off from Pātāla by Suparṇa; / having seized it, it was set down there, indeed, while the Nāgas watched. 2

16.352.s:
tato devyā tadā dṛṣṭvā rakṣitaṃ nāgapārśvataḥ ..
tataḥ suparṇeletyevaṃ khyātā sā vasudhātale .. 3 ..
16.352.d:
ततो देव्या तदा दृष्ट्वा रक्षितं नागपार्श्वतः ..
ततः सुपर्णेलेत्येवं ख्याता सा वसुधातले .. 3 ..
16.352.m: Then, having seen [it], it was protected by the goddess from the side of the Nāgas. / Therefore she became famed on the earth as Suparṇelā. 3

16.352.s:
ilā tu kathyate bhūmiḥ suparṇena pratiṣṭhitā ..
tataḥ suparṇeletyeva nāmnā pātakanāśinī .. 4 ..
16.352.d:
इला तु कथ्यते भूमिः सुपर्णेन प्रतिष्ठिता ..
ततः सुपर्णेलेत्येव नाम्ना पातकनाशिनी .. 4 ..
16.352.m: For 'ilā' is said to be the earth, established by Suparṇa; / therefore, by the name Suparṇelā, she destroys sins. 4

16.352.s:
suparṇakuṇḍe tatraiva snātvā tāṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyānnāpadbhirmriyate naraḥ ..
jīvavatsā bhavennārī ātmajaiścāpyalaṃkṛtā .. 5 ..
16.352.d:
सुपर्णकुण्डे तत्रैव स्नात्वा तां पूजयेन्नरः ..
विप्रेभ्यो भोजनं दद्यान्नापद्भिर्म्रियते नरः ..
जीववत्सा भवेन्नारी आत्मजैश्चाप्यलंकृता .. 5 ..
16.352.m: Bathing right there in Suparṇakuṇḍa, a person should worship her / and offer food to brahmins; that person does not die of misfortunes; / a woman will have living offspring and be adorned with sons. (5)

16.352.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye suparṇelāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..351..
16.352.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सुपर्णेलामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकपञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः ..351..
16.352.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fifty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Suparṇelā', in the First [Book], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the Seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (351)

16.353.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi bhallatīrthamanuttamam ..
tasyāśca paścime bhāge yatra viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ .. 1 ..
16.353.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि भल्लतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्याश्च पश्चिमे भागे यत्र विष्णुश्चतुर्भुजः .. 1 ..
16.353.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unexcelled Bhallatīrtha, / in the western part of it, where the four-armed Viṣṇu [dwells]; (1)

16.353.s:
yatra tyaktaṃ śarīraṃ tu viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
tasminmitravane ramye yojanārddhārddhavistṛte .. 2 ..
16.353.d:
यत्र त्यक्तं शरीरं तु विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
तस्मिन्मित्रवने रम्ये योजनार्द्धार्द्धविस्तृते .. 2 ..
16.353.m: where his body was abandoned by Viṣṇu, the all-powerful, / in that delightful Mitravana, extending over a quarter of a yojana. (2)

16.353.s:
yugeyuge mahādevi kalpamanvatarādiṣu ..
tatraiva saṃsthitirviṣṇornānyatra ca ratirbhavet .. 3 ..
16.353.d:
युगेयुगे महादेवि कल्पमन्वतरादिषु ..
तत्रैव संस्थितिर्विष्णोर्नान्यत्र च रतिर्भवेत् .. 3 ..
16.353.m: In every yuga, O great goddess, in kalpas, manvantaras, and the like, / Viṣṇu resides right there; he finds pleasure nowhere else. (3)

16.353.s:
kṣetrāṇāmādikṣetraṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ..
tisraḥ koṭyarddhakoṭiśca tīrthānāṃ pravarāṇi ca.. 4 ..
16.353.d:
क्षेत्राणामादिक्षेत्रं तु वैष्णवं तद्विदुर्बुधाः..
तिस्रः कोट्यर्द्धकोटिश्च तीर्थानां प्रवराणि च.. 4 ..
16.353.m: The wise know that it is the foremost sacred field of all sacred fields, sacred to Viṣṇu; / three and a half crores of eminent sacred fords (4)

16.353.s:
divi bhuvyaṃtarikṣe ca tāni tatraiva bhāmini..
tatra mūrtimatī gaṃgā svayameva vyavasthitā .. 5 ..
16.353.d:
दिवि भुव्यंतरिक्षे च तानि तत्रैव भामिनि..
तत्र मूर्तिमती गंगा स्वयमेव व्यवस्थिता .. 5 ..
16.353.m: in heaven, on earth, and in the mid-air are present right there, O beautiful lady; / Gaṅgā herself is situated there in embodied form. (5)

16.353.s:
viṣṇoḥ saṃplavanārthāya prāṇināṃ ca hitāya vai ..
gaṃgā gayā kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca .. 6 ..
16.353.d:
विष्णोः संप्लवनार्थाय प्राणिनां च हिताय वै ..
गंगा गया कुरुक्षेत्रं नैमिषं पुष्कराणि च .. 6 ..
16.353.m: For Viṣṇu's bathing and indeed for the welfare of living beings, / [there are] Gaṅgā, Gayā, Kurukṣetra, Naimiṣa, and the Puṣkaras. (6)

16.353.s:
purī dvāravatīṃ tyaktvā atraiva vasate hariḥ ..
tasyaurdhvadaihikaṃ devi prakaromi yugeyuge .. 7 ..
16.353.d:
पुरी द्वारवतीं त्यक्त्वा अत्रैव वसते हरिः ..
तस्यौर्ध्वदैहिकं देवि प्रकरोमि युगेयुगे .. 7 ..
16.353.m: Leaving the city of Dvāravatī, Hari dwells right here; / I perform his funeral rites, O goddess, yuga after yuga. (7)

16.353.s:
nabhasye dvādaśīyoge tatra gatvā svayaṃ priye ..
karomi tadvidhānena tatra brāhmaṇapuṃgavaiḥ .. 8 ..
16.353.d:
नभस्ये द्वादशीयोगे तत्र गत्वा स्वयं प्रिये ..
करोमि तद्विधानेन तत्र ब्राह्मणपुंगवैः .. 8 ..
16.353.m: Going there myself on the conjunction of the twelfth [tithi] in the month of Nabhasya, O beloved, / I perform [it] according to the ritual rule there with the foremost brahmins. (8)

16.353.s:
tatra dattvā tu dānāni vidhivadvedapārage ..
tatraiva dvādaśīyoge snātvā caiva vidhānataḥ .. 9 ..
16.353.d:
तत्र दत्त्वा तु दानानि विधिवद्वेदपारगे ..
तत्रैव द्वादशीयोगे स्नात्वा चैव विधानतः .. 9 ..
16.353.m: Having given gifts there according to the rule to one who has mastered the Veda, / and having bathed right there on the conjunction of the twelfth [tithi] according to the ritual rule, (9)

16.353.s:
santarpya ca pitṝnbhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ..
tatra viṣṇuṃ tu saṃpūjya kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi .. 7.1.352.10 ..
16.353.d:
सन्तर्प्य च पितॄन्भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ..
तत्र विष्णुं तु संपूज्य कृत्वा जागरणं निशि .. 7.1.352.10 ..
16.353.m: and having gratified the ancestors with devotion, one is freed from all sins; / having worshiped Viṣṇu there and kept a vigil at night, (10)

16.353.s: dīpādidānaṃ kṛtvā tu kṛtakṛtyo'bhijāyate .. 11 ..
16.353.d: दीपादिदानं कृत्वा तु कृतकृत्योऽभिजायते .. 11 ..
16.353.m: and having made donations such as lamps, one becomes one who has accomplished his purpose. (11)

16.353.s:
atha tasya pravakṣyāmi purāvṛtta mahaṃ priye ..
saṃhṛtya yādavānsarvānvāsudevaḥ pratāpavān .. 12 ..
16.353.d:
अथ तस्य प्रवक्ष्यामि पुरावृत्त महं प्रिये ..
संहृत्य यादवान्सर्वान्वासुदेवः प्रतापवान् .. 12 ..
16.353.m: Now I shall tell you its ancient event, O beloved: / having destroyed all the Yādavas, the mighty Vāsudeva, (12)

16.353.s:
durvāsasā'nuliptena pāyasena padastale ..
vajrāṃgabhūtadehastu sarvavyāpī janārddanaḥ .. .. 13 ..
16.353.d:
दुर्वाससाऽनुलिप्तेन पायसेन पदस्तले ..
वज्रांगभूतदेहस्तु सर्वव्यापी जनार्द्दनः .. .. 13 ..
16.353.m: his body having become like an adamantine limb / through the milk-rice smeared by Durvāsas on the soles of his feet, the all-pervading Janārdana (13)

16.353.s:
gatvā tīre samudrasya samādhistho babhūva ha ..
sarvasrotāṃsi saṃyamya niveśyātmānamātmani .. 14 ..
16.353.d:
गत्वा तीरे समुद्रस्य समाधिस्थो बभूव ह ..
सर्वस्रोतांसि संयम्य निवेश्यात्मानमात्मनि .. 14 ..
16.353.m: went to the shore of the ocean and entered into absorption, / restraining all his senses and placing the self within the Self. (14)

16.353.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto bāṇahasto jarābhidhaḥ ..
dāśaputro'tikṛṣṇāṃgo matsyaghātī ca pāpakṛt .. 15 ..
16.353.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो बाणहस्तो जराभिधः ..
दाशपुत्रोऽतिकृष्णांगो मत्स्यघाती च पापकृत् .. 15 ..
16.353.m: Meanwhile, one named Jarā arrived with an arrow in hand, / a fisherman's son, with very dark limbs, a killer of fish, and an evildoer. (15)

16.353.s:
tena dṛṣṭastato dūrānniṣādātmasamudbhavaḥ ..
viṣṇoḥ padaṃ mṛgaṃ matvā śaraṃ tasya mumoca ha .. 16 ..
16.353.d:
तेन दृष्टस्ततो दूरान्निषादात्मसमुद्भवः ..
विष्णोः पदं मृगं मत्वा शरं तस्य मुमोच ह .. 16 ..
16.353.m: Seen by him from afar—that son born of a Niṣāda— / mistaking Viṣṇu's foot for a deer, he released an arrow at him. (16)

16.353.s:
tato'sau paśyate yāvadgatvā tasya ca saṃnidhau ..
caturbāhuṃ mahākāyaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam .. 17 ..
16.353.d:
ततोऽसौ पश्यते यावद्गत्वा तस्य च संनिधौ ..
चतुर्बाहुं महाकायं शंखचक्रगदाधरम् .. 17 ..
16.353.m: Then, as soon as he went into his presence and looked, [he saw] / the four-armed one of huge body, bearing conch, discus, and mace, (17)

16.353.s:
puruṣaṃ nīlameghābhaṃ puḍarīkanibhe kṣaṇam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayabhītastu vepamānaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
abravīnna mayā jñātastvaṃ vibho divyarūpadhṛk .. 18 ..
16.353.d:
पुरुषं नीलमेघाभं पुडरीकनिभे क्षणम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा भयभीतस्तु वेपमानः कृतांजलिः ..
अब्रवीन्न मया ज्ञातस्त्वं विभो दिव्यरूपधृक् .. 18 ..
16.353.m: the person resembling a dark cloud, with eyes resembling lotuses; / seeing him, terrified with fear, trembling, with folded hands, / he said: 'I did not recognize you, O all-pervading lord bearing a divine form. (18)

16.353.s:
ajñānāttvaṃ mayā viddhastvatpadāgre surottama ..
kṣantumarhasi me nātha na tvaṃ kroddhumihārhasi .. 19 ..
16.353.d:
अज्ञानात्त्वं मया विद्धस्त्वत्पदाग्रे सुरोत्तम ..
क्षन्तुमर्हसि मे नाथ न त्वं क्रोद्धुमिहार्हसि .. 19 ..
16.353.m: Through ignorance, you were struck by me on the tip of your foot, O best of the gods; / you ought to forgive me, O lord; you ought not to be angry here.' (19)

16.353.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
śāpasyāṃtodya me bhadra śarapātātkṛtastvayā ..
tasmāttvaṃ matprasādena svargaṃ gaccha mahādyute .. 7.1.352.20 ..
16.353.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
शापस्यांतोद्य मे भद्र शरपातात्कृतस्त्वया ..
तस्मात्त्वं मत्प्रसादेन स्वर्गं गच्छ महाद्युते .. 7.1.352.20 ..
16.353.m: Viṣṇu said: / 'The end of my curse has been brought about today by you, O gentle one, by the strike of your arrow; / therefore, by my grace, go to heaven, O one of great splendor. (20)

16.353.s:
ye cānye māmihāgatya drakṣyaṃti hi narottamāḥ ..
te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatrāhaṃ nityasaṃsthitaḥ .. 21 ..
16.353.d:
ये चान्ये मामिहागत्य द्रक्ष्यंति हि नरोत्तमाः ..
ते यास्यंति परं स्थानं यत्राहं नित्यसंस्थितः .. 21 ..
16.353.m: And whatever other best of men, having come here, behold me, / they shall go to the supreme abode where I am eternally situated. (21)

16.353.s:
bhallenāhaṃ yato viddhastvayā pādatale śubhe ..
bhallatīrthamiti khyātaṃ tato hyetadbhaviṣyati .. 22 ..
16.353.d:
भल्लेनाहं यतो विद्धस्त्वया पादतले शुभे ..
भल्लतीर्थमिति ख्यातं ततो ह्येतद्भविष्यति .. 22 ..
16.353.m: Because I was struck by you on the auspicious sole of the foot with a bhalla arrow, / therefore this will be known as Bhallatīrtha. (22)

16.353.s: harikṣetramiti proktaṃ pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve'ntare .. 23 ..
16.353.d: हरिक्षेत्रमिति प्रोक्तं पूर्वं स्वायंभुवेऽन्तरे .. 23 ..
16.353.m: Previously, in the Svāyambhuva manvantara, it was declared as Harikṣetra.' (23)

16.353.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktvāṃtardadhe viṣṇurlubdhako'pi divaṃ gataḥ ..
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ ..
viṣṇulokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti prītyā te matprasādataḥ .. 24 ..
16.353.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे विष्णुर्लुब्धकोऽपि दिवं गतः ..
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति भक्त्या परमया युताः ..
विष्णुलोकं गमिष्यंति प्रीत्या ते मत्प्रसादतः .. 24 ..
16.353.m: Īśvara said: / Having spoken thus, Viṣṇu vanished, and the hunter also went to heaven. / Those who take a bath here, endowed with supreme devotion, / will go out of love to the world of Viṣṇu by my grace. (24)

16.353.s:
ye'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ..
tṛptiṃ teṣāṃ gamiṣyaṃti pitaraścaiva tarpitāḥ .. 25 ..
16.353.d:
येऽत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यंति पितृभक्तिपरायणाः ..
तृप्तिं तेषां गमिष्यंति पितरश्चैव तर्पिताः .. 25 ..
16.353.m: Those who perform a śrāddha here, dedicated to devotion to the ancestors, / their ancestors, having been gratified, shall attain satisfaction. (25)

16.353.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena prāpya tatkṣetramuttamam ..
dṛśyo devaścaturbāhuḥ snātvā tīrthe tu bhallake .. 26 ..
16.353.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन प्राप्य तत्क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
दृश्यो देवश्चतुर्बाहुः स्नात्वा तीर्थे तु भल्लके .. 26 ..
16.353.m: Therefore, having reached that supreme sacred field by every effort, / the four-armed god must be seen after bathing in the Bhalla tīrtha. (26)

16.353.s:
madbhaktibaladarpiṣṭhā matpriyaṃ na namaṃti ye ..
vāsudevaṃ na te jñeyā madbhaktāḥ pāpino hi te..27..
16.353.d:
मद्भक्तिबलदर्पिष्ठा मत्प्रियं न नमंति ये ..
वासुदेवं न ते ज्ञेया मद्भक्ताः पापिनो हि ते..27..
16.353.m: Those who, excessively arrogant in the strength of devotion to me, do not bow to my beloved / Vāsudeva, they are not to be known as my devotees; they are indeed sinners. (27)

16.353.s:
madbhakto'pi hi yo bhūtvā bhuṃkta ekādaśīdine..
malliṃgasyārcanaṃ kāryaṃ na tena pāpabuddhinā..28..
16.353.d:
मद्भक्तोऽपि हि यो भूत्वा भुंक्त एकादशीदिने..
मल्लिंगस्यार्चनं कार्यं न तेन पापबुद्धिना..28..
16.353.m: Even one who, having become my devotee, eats on the eleventh day, / worship of my liṅga should not be done by that evil-minded person. (28)

16.353.s:
yā tithirdayitā viṣṇoḥ sā tithirmama vallabhā..
na tāṃ copoṣayedyastu sa pāpiṣṭhatarādhikaḥ..29..
16.353.d:
या तिथिर्दयिता विष्णोः सा तिथिर्मम वल्लभा..
न तां चोपोषयेद्यस्तु स पापिष्ठतराधिकः..29..
16.353.m: The lunar day that is dear to Viṣṇu, that lunar day is beloved to me; / one who does not fast on it is more sinful than the most sinful. (29)

16.353.s:
tadvatsa dvādaśīyoge bhallatīrthasya saṃnidhau..
yastu māṃ pūjayedbhaktyā nārī vā'pi naro'pi vā ..
tasya janmasahasrāṇi gṛhabhaṃgo na jāyate..7.1.352.30..
16.353.d:
तद्वत्स द्वादशीयोगे भल्लतीर्थस्य संनिधौ..
यस्तु मां पूजयेद्भक्त्या नारी वाऽपि नरोऽपि वा ..
तस्य जन्मसहस्राणि गृहभंगो न जायते..7.1.352.30..
16.353.m: Likewise, on the conjunction of the twelfth [tithi] in the vicinity of Bhallatīrtha, / whoever worships me with devotion, whether a woman or a man, / for a thousand births, no ruin of their house occurs. (30)

16.353.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam..
bhallatīrthasya viṣṇostu sarva pātakanāśanam ..31..
16.353.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम्..
भल्लतीर्थस्य विष्णोस्तु सर्व पातकनाशनम् ..31..
16.353.m: Thus has this glory of Viṣṇu's Bhallatīrtha, / which destroys sins and eradicates all evil, been spoken, O goddess. (31)

16.353.s:
tatra viṣṇostu sāṃnidhye vāyavye kumbhamuttamam..
bhallatīrthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ yatra bhallahato hariḥ ..32..
16.353.d:
तत्र विष्णोस्तु सांनिध्ये वायव्ये कुम्भमुत्तमम्..
भल्लतीर्थं तु विख्यातं यत्र भल्लहतो हरिः ..32..
16.353.m: There, in the presence of Viṣṇu, in the northwest, is the excellent pitcher, / celebrated as Bhallatīrtha, where Hari was struck by the arrow. (32)

16.353.s:
tatra deyāni vāsāṃsi padaṃ gāvo vidhānataḥ ..
deyāni vipramukhyebhyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ..33..
16.353.d:
तत्र देयानि वासांसि पदं गावो विधानतः ..
देयानि विप्रमुख्येभ्यः सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः..33..
16.353.m: There, garments, footsteps, and cows should be given according to the rule / to the foremost brahmins by those who desire the full fruit of pilgrimage. (33)

16.353.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhallatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..352..
16.353.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भल्लतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विपञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः ..352..
16.353.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fifty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Bhallatīrtha', in the First [Book], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the Seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (352)

16.354.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kardamālamanuttamam ..
tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.354.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कर्दमालमनुत्तमम् ..
तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.354.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unexcelled Kardamāla, / a sacred ford renowned in the three worlds, which destroys all sins. (1)

16.354.s:
tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame ..
candrārkatapane naṣṭe jyotiṣi pralayaṃ gate .. 2 ..
16.354.d:
तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजंगमे ..
चन्द्रार्कतपने नष्टे ज्योतिषि प्रलयं गते .. 2 ..
16.354.m: When there was that terrible single ocean, when the moving and unmoving were destroyed, / when the moon and the burning sun were destroyed, and the celestial lights had dissolved, (2)

16.354.s:
rasātalagatāmurvīṃ dṛṣṭvā devo janārdanaḥ ..
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya daṃṣṭrāgreṇa varānane ..
utkṣipya dharaṇīṃ mūrdhnā svasthāne saṃnyaveśayat .. 3..
16.354.d:
रसातलगतामुर्वीं दृष्ट्वा देवो जनार्दनः ..
वाराहं रूपमास्थाय दंष्ट्राग्रेण वरानने ..
उत्क्षिप्य धरणीं मूर्ध्ना स्वस्थाने संन्यवेशयत् .. 3..
16.354.m: seeing the earth gone down to Rasātala, Lord Janārdana, / having assumed the form of a boar, O fair-faced lady, / having lifted the earth on his head with the tip of his tusk, established it in its proper place. (3)

16.354.s: uddhṛtya bhagavānviṣṇurvākyametaduvāca ha .. 4 ..
16.354.d: उद्धृत्य भगवान्विष्णुर्वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 4 ..
16.354.m: Having lifted it up, the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu spoke these words: (4)

16.354.s:
atra sthāne sthitenaiva mayā tvaṃ devi coddhṛtā ..
mamātra niyataṃ vāsaḥ sadaivāyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 5 ..
16.354.d:
अत्र स्थाने स्थितेनैव मया त्वं देवि चोद्धृता ..
ममात्र नियतं वासः सदैवायं भविष्यति .. 5 ..
16.354.m: "Remaining in this very place, O goddess, you were lifted up by me. / My dwelling here shall always be permanent."

16.354.s:
ye pitṝṃstarpayiṣyaṃti kardamāle varānane ..
ākalpaṃ tarpitāstena bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 6 ..
16.354.d:
ये पितॄंस्तर्पयिष्यंति कर्दमाले वरानने ..
आकल्पं तर्पितास्तेन भविष्यंति न संशयः .. 6 ..
16.354.m: "Those who offer libations to the ancestors at Kardamāla, O fair-faced one, / by that their ancestors will be satisfied until the end of the kalpa, without doubt."

16.354.s:
tatra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti śākairmūlaphalena vā ..
bhaviṣyati kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu vai śubhe .. 7 ..
16.354.d:
तत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यंति शाकैर्मूलफलेन वा ..
भविष्यति कृतं श्राद्धं सर्वतीर्थेषु वै शुभे .. 7 ..
16.354.m: "If they perform a śrāddha there with vegetables, roots, or fruit, / a śrāddha will be [as good as] performed in all sacred fords, O auspicious one."

16.354.s:
atra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā yo māṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ..
api kīṭapataṃgā ye nidhanaṃ yāṃti mānavāḥ ..
te mṛtāstri divaṃ yānti sukṛtena yathā dvijāḥ .. 8 ..
16.354.d:
अत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा यो मां पश्यति मानवः ..
अपि कीटपतंगा ये निधनं यांति मानवाः ..
ते मृतास्त्रि दिवं यान्ति सुकृतेन यथा द्विजाः .. 8 ..
16.354.m: "When a person has bathed in this sacred ford and beholds me, / even insects, moths, and men who meet their death, / upon dying go to heaven through their merit, like twice-born [brahmins]."

16.354.s:
tato dvīpeṣu jāyante dhanāḍhyāścottame kule ..
daṃṣṭrābhedena yattoyaṃ nirgataṃ te śarīrataḥ .. 9 ..
16.354.d:
ततो द्वीपेषु जायन्ते धनाढ्याश्चोत्तमे कुले ..
दंष्ट्राभेदेन यत्तोयं निर्गतं ते शरीरतः .. 9 ..
16.354.m: "Then they are born in the [various] continents, rich in wealth and in the highest family. / The water that issued from your body when pierced by the tusk,"

16.354.s: tatra snātvā naro devi tiryagyonau na jāyate .. 7.1.353.10 ..
16.354.d: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो देवि तिर्यग्योनौ न जायते .. 7.1.353.10 ..
16.354.m: "having bathed therein, O goddess, a man is not born into the womb of an animal."

16.354.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi yathāvṛttamāścaryaṃ tatra vai purā ..
mṛgayūthaṃ susantrastaṃ lubdhakaiḥ paripīḍitam ..
praviṣṭaṃ kardamāle tu sadyo mānuṣatāṃ gatam .. 11 ..
16.354.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि यथावृत्तमाश्चर्यं तत्र वै पुरा ..
मृगयूथं सुसन्त्रस्तं लुब्धकैः परिपीडितम् ..
प्रविष्टं कर्दमाले तु सद्यो मानुषतां गतम् .. 11 ..
16.354.m: Īśvara said: / Hear, O goddess, the wonder that truly took place there in ancient times. / A herd of deer, utterly terrified and tormented by hunters, / entered Kardamāla and instantly attained human form.

16.354.s:
atha te lubdhakā dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ..
apṛcchaṃta ca saṃbhrātāstānmartyānvaravarṇini .. 12 ..
16.354.d:
अथ ते लुब्धका दृष्ट्वा विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ..
अपृच्छंत च संभ्रातास्तान्मर्त्यान्वरवर्णिनि .. 12 ..
16.354.m: Then those hunters, seeing it with eyes wide with astonishment, / bewildered, questioned those humans, O fair-complexioned one:

16.354.s:
mṛgayūthamanuprāptaṃ kena mārgeṇa nirgatam ..
athocuste vayaṃ prāptā mānuṣaṃ mṛgarūpiṇaḥ .. 13 ..
16.354.d:
मृगयूथमनुप्राप्तं केन मार्गेण निर्गतम् ..
अथोचुस्ते वयं प्राप्ता मानुषं मृगरूपिणः .. 13 ..
16.354.m: "By which path has the herd of deer that came here departed?" / Then they said: "We who had the form of deer have attained human form;

16.354.s:
etattīrthaprabhāvo'yaṃ na vidmo hyātma kāraṇam ..
tataste lubdhakāstyaktvā dhanūṃṣi saśarāṇi ca ..
tatra snātvā mahābhāge muktāśca sarvapātakaiḥ .. 14 ..
16.354.d:
एतत्तीर्थप्रभावोऽयं न विद्मो ह्यात्म कारणम् ..
ततस्ते लुब्धकास्त्यक्त्वा धनूंषि सशराणि च ..
तत्र स्नात्वा महाभागे मुक्ताश्च सर्वपातकैः .. 14 ..
16.354.m: this is the power of this sacred ford; we do not know the cause ourselves." / Thereupon those hunters cast away their bows and arrows, / bathed there, O highly fortunate one, and were freed from all sins.

16.354.s:
.. pārvatyuvāca .. ..
bhagavanvistaraṃ brūhi kardamālamahodayam ..
utpattiṃ ca vidhānaṃ ca kṣetrasīmādikaṃ kramāt .. 15 ..
16.354.d:
.. पार्वत्युवाच .. ..
भगवन्विस्तरं ब्रूहि कर्दमालमहोदयम् ..
उत्पत्तिं च विधानं च क्षेत्रसीमादिकं क्रमात् .. 15 ..
16.354.m: Pārvatī said: / O Lord, tell me in detail the great glory of Kardamāla, / its origin, the rituals, and the boundaries of the sacred field in due order.

16.354.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi rahasyaṃ tu karda mālasamudbhavam ..
gūḍhaṃ brahmarṣisarvasvaṃ na deyaṃ kasyacittvayā .. 16 ..
16.354.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि रहस्यं तु कर्द मालसमुद्भवम् ..
गूढं ब्रह्मर्षिसर्वस्वं न देयं कस्यचित्त्वया .. 16 ..
16.354.m: Īśvara said: / Hear, O goddess, the secret of the origin of Kardamāla, / hidden, the all-in-all of brahmin seers; you must not give it to anyone.

16.354.s:
pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame ..
candrārkapavane naṣṭe jyotiṣi pralayaṃ gate .. 17 ..
16.354.d:
पूर्वमेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजंगमे ..
चन्द्रार्कपवने नष्टे ज्योतिषि प्रलयं गते .. 17 ..
16.354.m: Formerly, in the terrible single ocean, when the moving and unmoving had perished, / when the moon, sun, and wind were destroyed, and light had dissolved into cosmic dissolution,

16.354.s:
ekārṇavaṃ jagadidaṃ brahmāpaśyadaśeṣataḥ ..
tasminvasumatī magnā pātālatalamāgatā .. 18 ..
16.354.d:
एकार्णवं जगदिदं ब्रह्मापश्यदशेषतः ..
तस्मिन्वसुमती मग्ना पातालतलमागता .. 18 ..
16.354.m: Brahmā saw this entire universe as a single ocean. / The earth, immersed in it, had sunk to the depths of Pātāla.

16.354.s:
tato yajñavarāho'sau kṛtvā yajñamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
uddadhāra mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ daṃṣṭrāgreṇa varānane .. 19 ..
16.354.d:
ततो यज्ञवराहोऽसौ कृत्वा यज्ञमयं वपुः ..
उद्दधार महीं कृत्स्नां दंष्ट्राग्रेण वरानने .. 19 ..
16.354.m: Then that sacrificial boar, assuming a body composed of sacrifice, / lifted up the entire earth with the tip of his tusk, O fair-faced one.

16.354.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
.. vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ kratudaṃtaḥsrucīmukhaḥ ..
agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣā mahātapāḥ .. 7.1.353.20 ..
16.354.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
.. वेदपादो यूपदंष्ट्रः क्रतुदंतःस्रुचीमुखः ..
अग्निजिह्वो दर्भरोमा ब्रह्मशीर्षा महातपाः .. 7.1.353.20 ..
16.354.m: Īśvara said: / With the Vedas for his feet, the sacrificial post for his tusk, the sacrifices for his teeth, the sruc-ladle for his mouth, / with fire for his tongue, darbha grass for his hair, Brahmā for his head, of great austerity;

16.354.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
ahorātrekṣaṇaparo vedāṃgaśrutibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
ājyanāsaḥ sruvatuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān .. 21 ..
16.354.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
अहोरात्रेक्षणपरो वेदांगश्रुतिभूषणः ..
आज्यनासः स्रुवतुण्डः सामघोषस्वनो महान् .. 21 ..
16.354.m: Īśvara said: / having day and night for his supreme eyes, adorned with the limbs of the Vedas and the śruti, / with ghee for his snout, the sruva-ladle for his mouth, having the great sound of the Sāmaveda chant;

16.354.s:
prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimānmātrādīkṣābhirāvṛtaḥ ..
dakṣiṇā hṛdayo yogī mahāsatramaho mahān .. 22 ..
16.354.d:
प्राग्वंशकायो द्युतिमान्मात्रादीक्षाभिरावृतः ..
दक्षिणा हृदयो योगी महासत्रमहो महान् .. 22 ..
16.354.m: his body the prāgvaṃśa hall, radiant, surrounded by matras and dīkṣās, / having sacrificial fees for his heart, an ascetic, the great majesty of the great soma sacrifice;

16.354.s:
upākarmoṣṭharucakaḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ ..
nānācchandogatipatho brahmoktakramavikramaḥ ..23 ..
16.354.d:
उपाकर्मोष्ठरुचकः प्रवर्ग्यावर्तभूषणः ..
नानाच्छन्दोगतिपथो ब्रह्मोक्तक्रमविक्रमः ..23 ..
16.354.m: having the upākarma rite for the ornament of his lips, adorned with the pravargya circle, / his gait the paths of various Vedic meters, his strides following the order taught by the Veda;

16.354.s:
bhūtvā yajñavarāho'sāvuddadhāra mahīṃ tataḥ ..
tasyoddhṛtavataḥ pṛthvīṃ daṃṣṭrāgraṃ nirgataṃ bahiḥ .. 24 ..
16.354.d:
भूत्वा यज्ञवराहोऽसावुद्दधार महीं ततः ..
तस्योद्धृतवतः पृथ्वीं दंष्ट्राग्रं निर्गतं बहिः .. 24 ..
16.354.m: becoming that sacrificial boar, he then lifted up the earth. / As he lifted the earth, the tip of his tusk emerged outwardly.

16.354.s:
tasminprābhāsike kṣetre karddamena vilepitam ..
taddaṃṣṭrāgraṃ yato devi karddamālaṃ tataḥ smṛtam .. 25 ..
16.354.d:
तस्मिन्प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे कर्द्दमेन विलेपितम् ..
तद्दंष्ट्राग्रं यतो देवि कर्द्दमालं ततः स्मृतम् .. 25 ..
16.354.m: In that sacred field of Prabhāsa, [the earth] was smeared with mud / by the tip of that tusk; therefore, O goddess, it is remembered as Kardamāla.

16.354.s:
daṇḍodbhedaṃ mahākuṇḍaṃ yatra daṃṣṭrā susaṃsthitā ..
taddaṃṣṭrayoddhṛtaṃ toyaṃ koṭigaṃgābhiṣekavat .. 26 ..
16.354.d:
दण्डोद्भेदं महाकुण्डं यत्र दंष्ट्रा सुसंस्थिता ..
तद्दंष्ट्रयोद्धृतं तोयं कोटिगंगाभिषेकवत् .. 26 ..
16.354.m: The great basin where the tusk firmly stood is Daṇḍodbheda; / the water brought forth by that tusk is like an ablution in ten million Gaṅgā rivers.

16.354.s:
tatra gavyūti mātraṃ tu viṣṇukṣetraṃ sanātanam ..
deśāṃtaraṃ gatā ye ca daṇḍodbhede mriyaṃti vai ..
yāvatkalpasahasrāṇi viṣṇulokaṃ vrajaṃti te ..27..
16.354.d:
तत्र गव्यूति मात्रं तु विष्णुक्षेत्रं सनातनम् ..
देशांतरं गता ये च दण्डोद्भेदे म्रियंति वै ..
यावत्कल्पसहस्राणि विष्णुलोकं व्रजंति ते ..27..
16.354.m: Measuring one gavyūti there is the eternal sacred field of Viṣṇu. / Those who have gone to another land and die at Daṇḍodbheda / go to the world of Viṣṇu for as many thousand kalpas.

16.354.s:
yastu paśyenmahādevi kardamāle tu sūkaram ..
koṭihiṃsāyuto vāpi sa prāpsyati parāṃ gatim .. 28 ..
16.354.d:
यस्तु पश्येन्महादेवि कर्दमाले तु सूकरम् ..
कोटिहिंसायुतो वापि स प्राप्स्यति परां गतिम् .. 28 ..
16.354.m: Whoever beholds the Boar at Kardamāla, O great goddess, / even if possessed of ten million acts of violence, he will attain the supreme state.

16.354.s:
daśajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyettaddarśanātpriye ..
janmāntarasahasreṣu yatkṛtaṃ pāpasaṃcayam .. 29 ..
16.354.d:
दशजन्मकृतं पापं नश्येत्तद्दर्शनात्प्रिये ..
जन्मान्तरसहस्रेषु यत्कृतं पापसंचयम् .. 29 ..
16.354.m: The sin committed in ten lifetimes is destroyed by the sight of him, O beloved; / whatever store of sins has been accumulated in a thousand other lifetimes,

16.354.s:
kardamāle tu vārāhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tannāśameṣyati ..
hemakoṭisahasrāṇi gavāṃ koṭiśatāni ca .. 7.1.353.30 ..
16.354.d:
कर्दमाले तु वाराहं दृष्ट्वा तन्नाशमेष्यति ..
हेमकोटिसहस्राणि गवां कोटिशतानि च .. 7.1.353.30 ..
16.354.m: upon seeing the Boar at Kardamāla, it will go to destruction. / Giving thousands of ten millions of gold coins and hundreds of ten millions of cows—

16.354.s:
dattvā yallabhate puṇyaṃ sakṛdvārāhadarśanāt ..
kalau yuge mahāraudre prāṇināṃ ca bhayāvahe ..
nānyatra jāyate muktirmuktvā kṣetraṃ tu saukaram .. 31 ..
16.354.d:
दत्त्वा यल्लभते पुण्यं सकृद्वाराहदर्शनात् ..
कलौ युगे महारौद्रे प्राणिनां च भयावहे ..
नान्यत्र जायते मुक्तिर्मुक्त्वा क्षेत्रं तु सौकरम् .. 31 ..
16.354.m: whatever merit one obtains [by that], one obtains by a single darśana of the Boar. / In the Kali yuga, which is exceedingly terrible and brings fear to living beings, / liberation is not attained anywhere else, except in the sacred field of the Boar.

16.354.s:
etatsārataraṃ devi proktamuddeśatastava ..
karddamālasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 32 ..
16.354.d:
एतत्सारतरं देवि प्रोक्तमुद्देशतस्तव ..
कर्द्दमालस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 32 ..
16.354.m: This quintessential account has been declared briefly to you, O goddess, / the māhātmya of Kardamāla, which destroys all sins.

16.354.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye karddamālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..353 .. .. cha ..
16.354.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कर्द्दमालमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिपञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः ..353 .. .. छ ..
16.354.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fifty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Kardamāla,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.355.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devagupteśvaraṃ priye ..
tatra paścimavāyavye yatra somo'karottapaḥ .. 1 ..
16.355.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवगुप्तेश्वरं प्रिये ..
तत्र पश्चिमवायव्ये यत्र सोमोऽकरोत्तपः .. 1 ..
16.355.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the god Gupteśvara, O beloved, / there in the north-west, where the Moon performed austerity,

16.355.s:
gupto bhūtvā kuṣṭharogāllajjayādhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ ..
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu prabhāsakṣetra uttame .. 2 ..
16.355.d:
गुप्तो भूत्वा कुष्ठरोगाल्लज्जयाधोमुखः स्थितः ..
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु प्रभासक्षेत्र उत्तमे .. 2 ..
16.355.m: having hidden himself on account of leprosy, keeping his face down out of shame, / for a celestial thousand years in the excellent sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.355.s:
tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ yātaḥ sarvadevapatiḥ śivaḥ ..
tuṣṭo babhūva caṃdrasya kṣayanāśaṃ tathā'karot .. 3 ..
16.355.d:
ततः प्रत्यक्षतां यातः सर्वदेवपतिः शिवः ..
तुष्टो बभूव चंद्रस्य क्षयनाशं तथाऽकरोत् .. 3 ..
16.355.m: Then Śiva, the lord of all the gods, became visible to him; / he was pleased with the Moon and removed his consumption.
Freed from the disease of consumption, the hare-marked [Moon] then / established a great liṅga worshipped by gods and asuras.

16.355.s:
guptastepe tapo yasmāttasmādgupteśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sarvakuṣṭhaharo devo darśanātsparśanādapi .. 5 ..
16.355.d:
गुप्तस्तेपे तपो यस्मात्तस्माद्गुप्तेश्वरः स्मृतः ..
सर्वकुष्ठहरो देवो दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि .. 5 ..
16.355.m: Because he performed austerity while hidden, it is therefore remembered as Gupteśvara. / That god removes all leprosy through darśana and even through touch.

16.355.s:
somavāre viśeṣeṇa yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet ..
tasyānvaye'pi deveśi kuṣṭhī kaścinna jāyate .. 6 ..
16.355.d:
सोमवारे विशेषेण यस्तल्लिंगं प्रपूजयेत् ..
तस्यान्वयेऽपि देवेशि कुष्ठी कश्चिन्न जायते .. 6 ..
16.355.m: Whoever worships that liṅga, especially on a Monday, / in his lineage too, O ruler of gods, no leper is ever born.

16.355.s: iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gupteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 354 ..
16.355.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गुप्तेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुष्पञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 354 ..
16.355.m: Thus ends the three hundred and fifty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Gupteśvara,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.356.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ bahusuvarṇakam ..
hiraṇyāpūrvadigbhāge sthāne bahusuvarṇake .. 1 ..
16.356.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं बहुसुवर्णकम् ..
हिरण्यापूर्वदिग्भागे स्थाने बहुसुवर्णके .. 1 ..
16.356.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the god Bahusuvarṇaka, / in the eastern direction of the Hiraṇyā, in the place named Bahusuvarṇaka,

16.356.s:
dharmaputreṇa yatraiva kṛto yajñaḥ suduṣkaraḥ ..
nāmnā bahusuvarṇeti sthāpya liṃgaṃ mahāprabham .. 2 ..
16.356.d:
धर्मपुत्रेण यत्रैव कृतो यज्ञः सुदुष्करः ..
नाम्ना बहुसुवर्णेति स्थाप्य लिंगं महाप्रभम् .. 2 ..
16.356.m: where a sacrifice very difficult to perform was celebrated by the Son of Dharma, / after establishing a liṅga of great splendor, under the name Bahusuvarṇa.

16.356.s:
sarvakratūnāṃ phaladaṃ nāmnā sarveśvaraṃ viduḥ ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ liṃgaṃ pūrṇaṃ sārasvatairjalaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.356.d:
सर्वक्रतूनां फलदं नाम्ना सर्वेश्वरं विदुः ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं लिंगं पूर्णं सारस्वतैर्जलैः .. 3 ..
16.356.m: They know it by the name Sarveśvara, bestowing the fruit of all sacrifices. / In that very place is established the liṅga, filled with the waters of the Sarasvatī.

16.356.s:
snātvā tatra varārohe piṇḍadānaṃ dadāti yaḥ ..
kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya rudraloke mahīyate .. 4 ..
16.356.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र वरारोहे पिण्डदानं ददाति यः ..
कुलकोटिं समुद्धृत्य रुद्रलोके महीयते .. 4 ..
16.356.m:
Having bathed there, O fair-hipped lady, whoever gives an offering of rice balls,
uplifting ten million ancestors, is glorified in the world of Rudra.

16.356.s:
yastaṃ pūja yate bhaktyā gandhapuṣpairvidhānataḥ ..
koṭipūjāphalaṃ tasya tathetyāha sadāśivaḥ .. 5 ..
16.356.d:
यस्तं पूज यते भक्त्या गन्धपुष्पैर्विधानतः ..
कोटिपूजाफलं तस्य तथेत्याह सदाशिवः .. 5 ..
16.356.m:
Whoever worships it with devotion, with perfumes and flowers according to the rule,
obtains the fruit of ten million acts of worship; so declared Sadāśiva.

16.356.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bahusuvarṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 355 ..
16.356.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बहुसुवर्णेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चपञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 355 ..
16.356.m: Thus ends the three hundred fifty-fifth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Bahusuvarṇeśvara', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.357.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi śṛṃgeśvaramanuttamam ..
śukasthānasya sānnidhye sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.357.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि शृंगेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
शुकस्थानस्य सान्निध्ये सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.357.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassable Śṛṅgeśvara,
in the presence of Śukasthāna, which destroys all sins.

16.357.s:
snātvā tatraiva vidhivacchṛṃgeśaṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
muktaḥ syātpātakaiḥ sarvairṛṣyaśṛṃgo yathā purā .. 2 ..
16.357.d:
स्नात्वा तत्रैव विधिवच्छृंगेशं पूजयेन्नरः ..
मुक्तः स्यात्पातकैः सर्वैरृष्यशृंगो यथा पुरा .. 2 ..
16.357.m:
Having bathed right there according to rule, a man should worship Śṛṅgeśa;
he would be freed from all sins, just as Ṛṣyaśṛṅga was of old.

16.357.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śṛṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 356 ..
16.357.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शृंगेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्पञ्चाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 356 ..
16.357.m: Thus ends the three hundred fifty-sixth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Śṛṅgeśvara', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.358.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādīśānadigbhāge tatkoṭinagaraṃ smṛtam ..
tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge sthitaṃ yojanamātrakam ..
koṭīśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradam .. 1 ..
16.358.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादीशानदिग्भागे तत्कोटिनगरं स्मृतम् ..
तस्य दक्षिणदिग्भागे स्थितं योजनमात्रकम् ..
कोटीश्वरं महालिंगं कोटियज्ञफलप्रदम् .. 1 ..
16.358.m:
Īśvara said:
In the north-eastern direction from there is celebrated the city named Tatkoṭi;
situated just one yojana to its southern direction
is the great liṅga Koṭīśvara, which grants the fruit of ten million sacrifices.

16.358.s:
snātvā tatra vidhānena yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet .. 2 ..
16.358.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र विधानेन यस्तल्लिंगं प्रपूजयेत् ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैः कोटियज्ञफलं लभेत् .. 2 ..
16.358.m:
Having bathed there according to rule, whoever worships that liṅga
is freed from all sins and attains the fruit of ten million sacrifices.

16.358.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye koṭīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapaṃcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 357 ..
16.358.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कोटीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तपंचाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 357 ..
16.358.m: Thus ends the three hundred fifty-seventh chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Koṭīśvara', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.359.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇābhidham ..
tasyaiveśānadigbhāge vāpī śāṃḍilyakīrtitā .. 1 ..
16.359.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तीर्थं नारायणाभिधम् ..
तस्यैवेशानदिग्भागे वापी शांडिल्यकीर्तिता .. 1 ..

16.359.s:
snātvā tatraiva vidhivacchāṃḍilyaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet ..
ṛṣipaṃcamyāṃ vidhinā nārī caiva pativratā ..
spṛṣṭvāspṛṣṭvā vimucyeta rajodoṣabhayāddhruvam .. 2 ..
16.359.d:
स्नात्वा तत्रैव विधिवच्छांडिल्यं यः प्रपूजयेत् ..
ऋषिपंचम्यां विधिना नारी चैव पतिव्रता ..
स्पृष्ट्वास्पृष्ट्वा विमुच्येत रजोदोषभयाद्ध्रुवम् .. 2 ..
16.359.m:
Having bathed right there according to rule, whoever properly worships Śāṇḍilya—
and a devoted wife on Ṛṣipañcamī—
touching and touching again, she is certainly freed from the dread of the fault of menstruation.

16.359.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nārāyaṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmā ṣṭāpaṃcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 358 ..
16.359.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नारायणतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामा ष्टापंचाशदुत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 358 ..
16.359.m: Thus ends the three hundred fifty-eighth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of the Nārāyaṇa Sacred Ford', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.360.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sthānaṃ śṛṃgasaro'bhidham .. 1 ..
16.360.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि स्थानं शृंगसरोऽभिधम् .. 1 ..
16.360.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the place named Śṛṅgasaras.

16.360.s:
śṛṃgāreśvaranāmā ca tatra devaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
śṛṅgāraṃ vidhivaccakre yatra gopīyuto hariḥ .. 2 ..
16.360.d:
शृंगारेश्वरनामा च तत्र देवः प्रतिष्ठितः ..
शृङ्गारं विधिवच्चक्रे यत्र गोपीयुतो हरिः .. 2 ..
16.360.m:
The god named Śṛṅgāreśvara is consecrated there,
where Hari along with the cowherd women performed decoration according to rule.

16.360.s:
śṛṅgāreśvaranāmā ca tena pāpaughanāśanaḥ ..
pūjayedyo vidhānena tatra sthāne sthitaṃ bhavam ..
dāridryaduḥkhasaṃyukto na sa bhūyādbhave kvacit .. 3 ..
16.360.d:
शृङ्गारेश्वरनामा च तेन पापौघनाशनः ..
पूजयेद्यो विधानेन तत्र स्थाने स्थितं भवम् ..
दारिद्र्यदुःखसंयुक्तो न स भूयाद्भवे क्वचित् .. 3 ..
16.360.m:
He is named Śṛṅgāreśvara, and on that account he destroys the flood of sins.
Whoever worships Bhava established in that place according to rule
shall never in this worldly existence be afflicted with poverty and suffering.

16.360.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śṛṃgāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 359 ..
16.360.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शृंगारेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनषष्ट्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 359 ..
