16.360.m: Thus ends the three hundred fifty-ninth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Śṛṅgāreśvara', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.361.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyātaṭasaṃsthitam ..
ghaṭikāsthānamiti ca yatra siddhaḥ purā ṛṣiḥ .. 1 ..
16.361.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि हिरण्यातटसंस्थितम् ..
घटिकास्थानमिति च यत्र सिद्धः पुरा ऋषिः .. 1 ..
16.361.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the place called Ghaṭikāsthāna,
situated on the bank of the Hiraṇyā, where a seer attained perfection in ancient times.

16.361.s:
nāḍyaikayā mṛkaṇḍastu dhyānayogādvarānane ..
tatraiva sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ mārkaṃḍeśvaranāmataḥ ..
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ darśanātpūjanādapi .. 2 ..
16.361.d:
नाड्यैकया मृकण्डस्तु ध्यानयोगाद्वरानने ..
तत्रैव स्थापितं लिंगं मार्कंडेश्वरनामतः ..
सर्वपापोपशमनं दर्शनात्पूजनादपि .. 2 ..

16.361.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mārkaṃḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭyuttara triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 360 ..
16.361.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मार्कंडेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षष्ट्युत्तर त्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 360 ..
16.361.m: Thus ends the three hundred sixtieth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Mārkaṇḍeśvara', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.362.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi maṇḍūkeśvaramityapi ..
māṃḍūkyāyananāmnā vai liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.362.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि मण्डूकेश्वरमित्यपि ..
मांडूक्यायननाम्ना वै लिंगं तत्र प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..

16.362.s:
tatra koṭihrado devi tathā koṭīśvaraḥ śivaḥ ..
tatra mātṛgaṇaścaiva sthitaḥ kāmaphalapradaḥ .. 2 ..
16.362.d:
तत्र कोटिह्रदो देवि तथा कोटीश्वरः शिवः ..
तत्र मातृगणश्चैव स्थितः कामफलप्रदः .. 2 ..
16.362.m:
There is the pool Koṭihrada, O goddess, and likewise Koṭīśvara Śiva;
and there the troop of Mothers resides, which grants the fruits of desires.

16.362.s:
snātvā koṭi hrade tīrthe talliṃgaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet ..
mātṝstatraiva saṃpūjya duḥkhaśokādvimucyate .. 3 ..
16.362.d:
स्नात्वा कोटि ह्रदे तीर्थे तल्लिंगं यः प्रपूजयेत् ..
मातॄस्तत्रैव संपूज्य दुःखशोकाद्विमुच्यते .. 3 ..
16.362.m:
Having bathed at the sacred ford of Koṭihrada, whoever properly worships that liṅga
and worships the Mothers right there is freed from suffering and sorrow.

16.362.s:
tasmātpūrveṇa deveśi yojanaikena nirmalam ..
tritakūpeti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ..
sarveṣāṃ devi tīrthānāṃ yattatraiva vyavasthitiḥ .. 4 ..
16.362.d:
तस्मात्पूर्वेण देवेशि योजनैकेन निर्मलम् ..
त्रितकूपेति विख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
सर्वेषां देवि तीर्थानां यत्तत्रैव व्यवस्थितिः .. 4 ..
16.362.m:
One yojana to the east of that, O queen of gods, is the pure well
famed as Tritakūpa, which destroys all sins,
because, O goddess, all sacred fords reside right there.

16.362.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye koṭihrada maṇḍūkeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 361 ..
16.362.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कोटिह्रद मण्डूकेश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनं नामैकषष्ट्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 361 ..
16.362.m: Thus ends the three hundred sixty-first chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Koṭihrada and Maṇḍūkeśvara', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.363.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi goṣpadasyottare sthitam ..
gavyūtidvitayenaiva valāya iti viśrutam .. 1 ..
16.363.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गोष्पदस्योत्तरे स्थितम् ..
गव्यूतिद्वितयेनैव वलाय इति विश्रुतम् .. 1 ..
16.363.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the place situated to the north of Goṣpada,
at a distance of two gavyūtis, known as Valāya.

16.363.s:
tatraikādaśarudrāṇāṃ sthānaliṃgānyapi priye ..
ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ saṃtītyādīni nāmataḥ ..
pūjayettāni vidhivanmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.363.d:
तत्रैकादशरुद्राणां स्थानलिंगान्यपि प्रिये ..
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यः संतीत्यादीनि नामतः ..
पूजयेत्तानि विधिवन्मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 2 ..

16.363.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 362 ..
16.363.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विषष्ट्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 362 ..
16.363.m: Thus ends the three hundred sixty-second chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of the Eleven Rudra Liṅgas', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.364.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyātaṭasaṃsthitam ..
sthānaṃ tuṇḍapuraṃnāma yatrāsau ghargharo hradaḥ .. 1 ..
16.364.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि हिरण्यातटसंस्थितम् ..
स्थानं तुण्डपुरंनाम यत्रासौ घर्घरो ह्रदः .. 1 ..
16.364.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the place named Tuṇḍapura,
situated on the bank of the Hiraṇyā, where that pool Gharghara is located.

16.364.s:
tatra kandeśvaro devo yatra baddhā jaṭā mayā ..
tatra snātvā naraḥ samyaktṃ devaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet ..
sa muktaḥ pātakairghoraiḥ prāpnuyācchāsanaṃ śubham .. 2 ..
16.364.d:
तत्र कन्देश्वरो देवो यत्र बद्धा जटा मया ..
तत्र स्नात्वा नरः सम्यक्त्ं देवं यः प्रपूजयेत् ..
स मुक्तः पातकैर्घोरैः प्राप्नुयाच्छासनं शुभम् .. 2 ..

16.364.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye hiraṇyātuṇḍapura ghargharahradakandeśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatata mo'dhyāyaḥ ..363..
16.364.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये हिरण्यातुण्डपुर घर्घरह्रदकन्देश्वर माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिषष्ट्युत्तरत्रिशतत मोऽध्यायः ..363..
16.364.m: Thus ends the three hundred sixty-third chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of Hiraṇyā, Tuṇḍapura, the Gharghara Pool, and Kandeśvara', in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.365.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi saṃvarteśvaramuttamam ..
indreśvarātpaścimataḥ pūrvataścārkabhāskarāta .. 1 ..
16.365.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि संवर्तेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
इन्द्रेश्वरात्पश्चिमतः पूर्वतश्चार्कभास्करात .. 1 ..
16.365.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Saṃvarteśvara,
west of Indreśvara and east of Arkabhāskara.

16.365.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mahādevaṃ snātvā puṣkariṇījale ..
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 2 ..
16.365.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा तु महादेवं स्नात्वा पुष्करिणीजले ..
दशानामश्वमेधानां फलमाप्नोति मानवः .. 2 ..
16.365.m:
Having beheld that Mahādeva after bathing in the water of the lotus pond,
a person obtains the fruit of ten horse sacrifices.

16.365.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃvarteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 364 ..
16.365.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संवर्तेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुष्षष्ट्युत्तरत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः .. 364 ..
16.365.m: Thus ends the three hundred and sixty-fourth chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of Saṃvarteśvara," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. [364]
